dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_hard: Elite difficulty features an exceptional challenge for fearless players who have mastered combat. Monsters and traps are very deadly. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are greatly increased.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy crowns with energy.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2d: Actually, I have to run. Maybe some other time...
mission.properties|b.laboratory_visit: Biotech Morlin is in charge of the Lab located in the Haven Garrison. He seeks a capable knight willing to brave the Clockworks in order to secure a cache of 'battle sprites' lost during the crash of the Skylark.
item.properties|f.moonstone_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
guild.properties|i.guild_shop: Purchase guild furnishings and upgrades using funds from the Guild Treasury.
conversation.properties|r.vise_seerus: Sure, Vise.  I'll see what I can do.
exchange.properties|m.mobile_tooltip: Opens a page in your browser where you can buy Energy with your mobile phone.
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They came from the darkness. There was no time to react.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_1a: Have they sent you for me?  To bring me back?  No, I am where I belong now. I no longer serve the Spiral Order and will remain here. \n\nLeave this place and never come back.  Leave me be.
item.properties|f.medieval_war_helm: A heaume sturdily built to last for a hundred years of war.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_barrier: If you start feeling overwhelmed, use the force barriers like the one to your right to take a breather. Monsters and projectiles cannot pass through them.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Don't worry about Feron, he'll be healed up in no time.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r9: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.spiral_sallet: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
guildhelp.properties|m.storage_info: The Guild Storage acts like a community item bank. Guild members of the appropriate rank can add or remove equipment or items to the Storage as they see fit. It's a great way to share resources between guildmates, or to help out newer members\!\n WARNING\: Items placed in Guild Storage can be removed and claimed by any guild member with access to Guild Storage. Do not put items into Guild Storage that you want to keep for yourself\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_9a: You cannot stop what you cannot see.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.wild_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.turbillion: An ostentatious mechanized blade whose turbine crackles with the power of a thousand storms.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_shield: A kite shield haunted by a benevolent ghost. It should help you put up a spirited defense against shadow.
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft1:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into the depths of a moldering sewer where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
projectx.properties|m.some_options_resta: Some options may require a client restart to take effect.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...This world has seen few greater tragedies than the fall of the great Kingdom of Almire.  Once a vibrant, beautiful realm of lush forests and sweeping plains... 

...neighboring kingdoms declared war... 

...seeking the power needed to turn the tide, Lord Vanaduke of Almire fled into the mountains...
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_suit: A fine set of armor specially forged for those select few individuals who can handle explosives with panache and flair... while managing to avoid blowing themselves up.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_1a: What's this? Another poor soul ripe for harvest by the Apocrea?
projectx.properties|m.revisit_help: You can click on completed stages to revisit them.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: They burst out of the ground all around us...
uplink.properties|m.shard_bomb_reward:
Attention {0}\!  Some significant changes were recently made to the following bombs\: Crystal Bomb, Sun Shards, Rock Salt Bomb, Radiant Sun Shards and Ionized Salt Bomb.  

While we're confident that you'll enjoy the new way these bombs work, we also want you to know that we take changes like this seriously.  Enclosed is a thank you gift for having invested in one or more of these bombs before the change was made.  For more detailed information, please visit the official Spiral Knights Forums. 

Please accept these rewards and happy bombing\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: It's good to know Spiral HQ hasn't forgotten about me.
item.properties|f.omegaward: The pulsing elemental plates of this shield instantaneously react to adverse climates protecting you from even the most extreme cold or heat.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_sentin: A suit of armor reinforced with volcanic plating to defend against a range of elements.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_a: I always carry a variety of gear... just in case.
item.properties|m.heat_bonus: Doubles the amount of heat you will acquire.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Excellent\! Which battle sprite will you choose as your companion?
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_3: Truly you are among the greatest of all warriors who have ever lived\! The bounties of the Arena King are yours for the taking\!
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_2a: We can't say for sure just yet, but it would seem as though that however Cradle was formed, it included large pieces of other worlds around it.  If this is true then we've never seen anything like this before.
item.properties|f.hazardous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
mission.properties|o.abandoned_depot: Learn the basics of survival in the Abandoned Depot
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r3: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
helptips.properties|m.need_key_grim_gate: The Grim Gate requires a Fiendish ID Card to activate.
mission.properties|o.shadow_beast: Defeat the Snarbolax in the Gloaming Wildwoods and recover the recon module
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r6: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|f.confetti_equinox: When thrown, this spring confetti bursts with freshly sprouted grass and fragrant flowers. No rain required\!
sprites.properties|d.plentiful_pain: Increases the bonus duration of hexing haze as additional targets are acquired.
item.properties|f.obsidian_crusher: A peculiar bomb made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Despite it being a bomb, some are drawn to holding it and 'solving' it as if it were some kind of puzzle.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_lift_2: The door ahead is locked, but you can open it with the hit switch to your left. Try throwing a clay pot at the switch. They're quite useful in this way if you don't have a gun handy.
item.properties|f.teddy_bear_buckler: A high-tech energy shield disguised as a harmless teddy bear. The perfect companion to defend against minions of the night.
chat.properties|m.usage_hoh: Go to the Hall of Heroes
helptips.properties|m.atg_traps: Watch your step\!  Wait until TRAPS are down before walking over them.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_1a: This is Intel Agent Kora of Spiral HQ\! We have received a distress signal from your coordinates, do you read me?
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: We've had a few cases where knights have met non-hostile constructs that they swear behaved like true sentient creatures.  But that is very difficult to believe. Gremlins are brilliant, but brilliant at the kind of direct engineering that simply gets the job done and little else.  Brute force. \n\nArtificial life?  Well, that's something else entirely.
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy energy with crowns.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_gre: A Spiral-issued light source typically used at checkpoints.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_sub: Congratulations\! You subscribed to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
helptips.properties|m.shop: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to browse vendor goods.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_2a: You have a strange definition of recreation if that's the case.  Tier 3 fiends and undead are nothing to sneeze at, in fact they're among the worst creatures you'll find so close to the Core. \n\nDevilite management seems to be the worst at these depths and that results in some very violent devilites.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r7: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
sprites.properties|d.crystal_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal elemental damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Seraphynx
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2a: An official order from Herex, the Whispering Venom\: \n\nProduction of Compound 42 is to cease immediately.  While a formidable poison and no doubt useful in achieving a... 'higher' power amongst the Order, it seems to have formed an intelligence well beyond the scope of a standard bio-toxin.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_2: A flawed fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
item.properties|f.luminite: A fabled mineral of a radiant, golden color said to contain the faith, wisdom and zeal of the life surrounding it.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_blu: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.cloak: An extraordinary cloak favored by the students of the arcane.
item.properties|f.bombhead_mask: A mask commissioned by King Krogmo to celebrate the launch of Blast Network that curiously resembles a live bomb. Available in a wide variety of styles, there is likely one to match any armor set.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_paid: Upkeep paid\! {0} crowns removed from the guild treasury.
item.properties|f.guild_members_250: Allows your guild to recruit up to 250 members\!
item.properties|f.storm_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe created the world in its passing\: its fire the sun, its bones the mountains.
sprites.properties|d.enduring_night: Increases duration of the shadow cloak.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_heav: Hello {0}, I'm Izola, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad guardian.  The recipes I have for you produce highly defensive armor and hard-hitting weapons. \n\nHeavy weapons require precise timing to use effectively and the gear tends to slow you down some.  But what you sacrifice in usability is returned in sheer power.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad can depend upon to stay alive and face even the fiercest of monsters.
chat.properties|m.usage_pbroadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone on the current peer.
mission.properties|b.strength_unity: Something has riled up a pack of beasts in the Aurora Isles and they have descended upon a Geo Knight research team.  Cornered, the team has sent a distress signal and Spiral HQ has issued the task of saving them to you. \n\nBy standing together, the Geo Knights have made it this long but their time is running out. Assemble a team and confront the beasts that seek to devour your fellow knights\!
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_2a: You and me both. Now let's get- \n\nHold on, something's not right. Brace yourself, I think we've got company\!
dungeon.properties|m.lobby_desc: A lobby before entering a gate where knights can strategize and gear up for the adventure to come.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2d: Battle sprites gain perks at certain levels that you can equip within the battle sprite interface. Perks provide bonuses to your stats.
item.properties|f.prize_box: Contains unique {0} costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.polaris: It's said that the explosions caused by this stellar sidearm are so bright that you'll always be able to find your way in the darkness. Polaris shots become more powerful the further they travel.
pvp.properties|m.refunded: You have been refunded your Coliseum entrance fee of {0} crowns.
sprites.properties|d.venom: Increases the potency of the poison inflicted.
helptips.properties|m.wolver_den: Wolvers are a highly adaptable pack beast whose predatory instincts are only matched by their quick reflexes.  They play with their prey by dancing about and finally striking from behind.  Keep a blade handy.
mission.properties|o.first_contact: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_4a: Roger that Kora, I'm on my way\!
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_4a:
Perhaps Geo-Science has no place in this conversation?  You are correct, {0}. 

Moving on, shadow damage is produced by fiend and undead family monsters.  Additionally, fiend monsters tend to be weak to piercing damage and the undead to elemental damage. Keep this in mind. 

Now then, is there anything else you require?
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_1a: Hello {0}, I hope you're ready for me to send you out into the lion's den once more.
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t2: Help us test this new content.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_helm: A substantial helmet designed to take all kinds of abuse from conventional weaponry. The inside smells a little like sweat.
item.properties|f.royal_core: A sweet-smelling lump of ooze collected from a particularly noble specimen of slime.
item.properties|f.kat_tribe_fetish: A tattered fetish from the now-extinct Kat Tribe, the ferocious feline warriors responsible for the destruction of the Owlites and their prestigious High Academy of Magicks. The fetishes were carried into battle by Kat warriors and are said to bring good luck despite the ill fate of the Kat Tribe itself.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: I'm a field researcher working under Chief Geo Knight Wegner.
item.properties|f.confetti_bubbles: Use this item to blow a cloud of bubbles into the air. See how long they last before they pop\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_armor: Upgraded Circuit Breaker Armor further hacked to resist shock.
mission.properties|o.occurance_at_owlite: Locate the ancient tome within the haunted Owlite keep
item.properties|f.graviton_bomb: Capable of dragging enemies toward its location before exploding, this bomb utilizes technology that the Spiral Order does not fully understand.
item.properties|f.mega_magnus: An upgraded Magnus powerful enough to take a monster's head clean off. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_9: Another strange device\! This one was clearly not made by the Almirians any more than the previous device was made by jellies. One thing we've noticed however\: this device is still active. On top of that, the energy signature is similar to the readings we took off the Artifact before it was stolen. This requires some further research I think.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
item.properties|f.shining_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns like a star shining in the night sky.
item.properties|f.shade_armor: A suit of armor infused with dark matter that allows its wearer to shoot straight and surprise foes from the shadows.
support.properties|m.option_208_1:
If a player has already taken over your account, you will need to contact us via our support form to recover your account again.

Be aware we need proof of who owns the account, and we can only get this by confirming how the account was paid for.

Click here to start recovering your paid account which was taken over.
item.properties|f.heavy_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to pack a greater punch. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.primal_ore: An extraordinary metal imbued with the savage spirit of the wild.
guild.properties|log.door_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
pvp.properties|m.love_review_confirm: Are you sure? Once in review, you will no longer be able to make changes. Please completely test your level before submitting. It may take up to a week to review.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: My rescue team was ambushed by some giant mechanical horror. We didn't stand a chance. I'm glad you got here when you did, otherwise I don't know if we would have made it.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_1: Vials are one type of pickup. When thrown they release the alchemical agents within creating an elemental explosion. You can give them a try in the next room.
support.properties|m.item_granted_messag: You have been granted an item. Click below to claim.
item.properties|f.exp_east_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
guild.properties|e.item_treasury_limit: Sorry, an item you're trying to add is already at the limit for how many can be placed in a guild hall.
item.properties|m.forge_locked: The Forge can only be used in town or at Arsenal Stations.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_shield: A superior shield imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It is so resistant to high temperatures that it's a mystery how exactly it was forged in the first place.
support.properties|m.option_207_0: If you believe someone is maliciously trying to scam you, then please click here to send the complaint. You may want to inform this player they have been complained that way other players around you can hear this too and take precaution.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_bone_bon: Some people would call using a jumbled pile of bones as a decorative item "daring". Everyone else? "Creepy".
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r7: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_sight: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
item.properties|f.static_clinger: A latent strand of energy that floats throughout the Clockworks, frequently catching on hair and clothing. It's too large to properly distill into Energy, but it's very useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_bra: The path to Haven allows you to escape this perilous mountain and collect a haul of Grinchlin treasures along the way\! \n\nHowever, should you decide to pass on it now and continue up the mountain, even greater treasures await...
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_5a: That's right, you can acquire recipes and materials in order to alchemize weapons and gear at alchemy stations.  Come on, I'll show you one.
item.properties|f.needle_shot: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts at an alarming rate.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Continue to fight the good fight, {0}. Remember what you've learned. Farewell\!
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of crimsonite.
auction.properties|m.search_ready: Press 'Search' to execute your current search query.
pvp.properties|m.upload_wait: A file picking window is trying to show...
mission.properties|m.another_trace_1a: Hello {0}, I'm happy to report that my equipment is back up and running\! Now I have some good news and bad news for you.  The good news is\: I've been able to track down the source of that energy signature. Here is the bad news\: the energy source has been pinpointed to a highly dangerous area of the Clockworks that Recon Knights have dubbed the 'Royal Jelly Palace.'
mission.properties|r.arc_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_1: Head into the room ahead with the party pad. You're almost done.
logon.properties|m.too_many_attempts: You have made too many login attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_2: We're attempting to find a means to activate the Core through the power of the minerals found within the Clockworks.  Those minerals are capable of transforming the Clockworks- we have seen this in the Haven Arcade.  It is our belief that we can use that power to activate the Core and... open it somehow.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_standar: This is a regularly scheduled maintenance reboot. It will be available as soon as possible.
item.properties|f.prize_box_spiralhorn: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Ram\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Then scour the Clockworks for those wretched kats and destroy them\! Even if they ate the books you will be able to recover the Ancient Pages. These pages can be given to Montague in exchange for rewards. Help us and we'll help you\! \n\nBlack kats can be found randomly when encountering spookats in Tier 2 and Tier 3 (Arcade Gates and Missions). There is also a daily Prestige Mission that likely leads to a black kat nest.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_3a: Thank you, {0}.  I hope you succeed.  As you know, we believe the Alpha Squad made it this far, but it is unclear what became of them... Euclid, Parma, Grantz.... Rulen. \n\n(Lieutenant Vaelyn seems to almost drift off)
item.properties|f.slumber_squall: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a thick fog of sleepy mist.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_arcade: Select a gate to view the gate map and enable options for starting your expedition\!
item.properties|f.deadly_candy_poker: A toothache will be the least of their worries when you're armed with this perforating present.
sprites.properties|d.meteoric_firebol: Increases the size of the firebolt's explosion.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: Productivity is up two percent since I started mandatory overtime.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_2a: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
mission.properties|r.pioneers_11a: I'll do my best to recover the recon module and destroy the Snarbolax\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: Favored items can be alchemized using this very alchemy machine you see before you. All it takes is two of any one material and some minerals from the Clockworks. Easy\!
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_torrent: A environment with almost too much rain.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r4: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|m.chasm_b_rhendon_1a: Looks like we've got no choice, {0}.  This gizmo isn't worth dying over.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_armor: A suit of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
item.properties|f.savage_tortofist: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it you can feel the primal energy of a rampaging wolver pack within waiting to be unleashed.
social.properties|m.friend_party_progres: You must wait for {0}'s party to reach depth {1}.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I am ready to choose my battle sprite.
item.properties|f.celestial_orbitgun: This planetoid projecting pistol conjures images of the birth of stellar systems. Opponents caught within its blazing maelstrom are sure to see the light.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_timedow: The game will be unavailable for {0} during maintenance.
helptips.properties|m.sl_elevator_active: Shadow Key required to open.\nShadow Keys can be acquired randomly in lockboxes or purchased from the Supply Depot.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Shh, don't tell anyone I'm here.
support.properties|m.sent_mail: Sent mail with subject "{0}" to knight {1}.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r3: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_1a: How do sprites level up and evolve?
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_6a: They look like dragons from fairy tales.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: Welcome to our camp\! Have a seat by the campfire if you want a little break.
projectx.properties|e.not_enough_appetit: Not enough appetite to consume this item.
item.properties|f.flame_soul: A powerful essence left behind when a creature perishes during a blind, fiery rage.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_3a: It seems to lead to some kind of elevator, but with no power, the whole thing is just dead.
item.properties|f.prize_box_equinox: Contains various unique costumes and accessories celebrating Cradle's equinox\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.skelly_suit: A bone-chilling outfit that naturally wards off shadowy attacks.
item.properties|f.ironwood: A pristine log of one of the hardest substances known to the Spiral Knights.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_4: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing 5 Star gear and receive certification
item.properties|f.drake_scale_helm: A helmet crafted from the scales of beasts thought to be the descendants of dragons.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_3: A ceremonial shield issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
projectx.properties|i.limit_fps: Limit the frame rate to avoid overtaxing your video card, especially if offscreen.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It'll restrict your peripheral vision a bit, but it's virtually impregnable.
item.properties|f.supply_pack_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This compact pack has enough supplies to last a single Knight one week.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_1a: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.
item.properties|f.light_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.
conversation.properties|r.emberlight_vis: Why is King Tinkinzar trying to destroy Haven?
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
exchange.properties|m.confirm_low_sell:
Your sell offer has a lower price than the current best buy offer.
Probably you made a mistake.
Your sell price\: {0} crowns.
Best buy offer price\: {1} crowns.
Are you sure this is what you want?
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_helm: An illuminated helm strengthened against soporific smogs. It's surprisingly soft inside.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven. \n\nTo start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
mission.properties|r.laboratory_visit_3a: Sounds very useful. How do I get one?
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
item.properties|f.volt_oil: A slippery substance that always holds a slight electrical charge.
item.properties|f.ultra_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
item.properties|f.scale_helm: A helm crafted from the scales of a slithering beast.
item.properties|f.black_kat_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_helm: A special helm built to commemorate Isoran spacefarers of old.  With this equipped, you can see a clear path across the night sky to countless worlds beyond.
item.properties|f.almire_chair: A chiseled chair as ancient as Almire's ailing aristocrats.
item.properties|f.prize_box_decoration: Contains various festive decorations for your Guild Hall to help ring in the winterfest season.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
social.properties|m.watch_full: Oops\! That party is no longer accepting new watchers.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_3a: The Apocrea are stuff of nightmares\: a terrible legion of otherworldly phantasms whose only ambition seems to be trapping and devouring the souls of all life. \n\nThough you may venture beyond this nexus, you will undoubtedly fall into one of their traps along the way.
helptips.properties|m.loading11: If you become cursed some of your weapons will be marked by the curse. Trying to use a curse marked weapon will cause you damage.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_4a: Before you go, here's a few materials to get you started.  Good luck.
mission.properties|o.explosive_plot: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|o.weight_of_darkness: Prove your valor against a legion of supreme shadow monsters
item.properties|f.adv_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into even more advanced forms with even more powerful skills.
item.properties|f.shadowsun_slicker: An evil duster that is said to harbor a great power that feeds off of the unforgiven sins of its owners.
item.properties|f.cosmic_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_1a: This is {0} of the Skylark.  I read you loud and clear Kora.
dungeon.properties|m.core_desc: The ultimate objective of the Spiral Knights, the Core is like a titanic heart, ever beating life through the world surrounding it.
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_arrive: Captain Ozlo, the Skylark has identified the source of the powerful energy signature.
helptips.properties|m.test_lobby: Welcome testers\! Before you head off into the Clockworks, feel free to help yourself to some wonderful stuff from the merchant to the left. \nThe embers to the far right will level up weapons once your collect enough of them and proceed to the next floor. \nGood luck, brave knights\!
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4a: You talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
item.properties|f.rocket_sprocket: A sturdy sprocket used by machines that fire projectiles.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_2a: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: They say these minerals power every gate in the Arcade.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_inf: 'Speak with the one, true voice and they will listen. Quiet as a child's whisper, roaring like the death of this world.'
item.properties|f.wildfire: An elite handgun that can offer a tremendous surprise for the enemy on the battlefield as its small charges of energy transform into raging wildfires. Wildfire shots become more powerful the further they travel.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: What to Do if You Summon the Wrong Infernal Overlord
item.properties|f.super_blaster: A supercharged Blaster well-suited to longer expeditions down into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.gunslinger_hat: A mighty fine piece of headgear worn by pistol-packing warriors from a forgotten time. It's perfect for dueling, searching or drifting across high plains.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight6_1a: We're not taking any chances with this artifact you found, {0}. One day the gremlins might be back for it.  Be on your guard\!
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc3: The renaming item will be consumed.
exchange.properties|m.billing_spending_l: You have reached your spending limit. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|r.arc_mintut_1: I'm here to learn about the minerals found within the Clockworks.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_default: Upkeep not paid\! Guild Hall is in default.
sprites.properties|d.virulent_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit there is a chance to trigger a poisonous explosion.
item.properties|f.deadshot_chapeau: A mythical hat for those that never miss their mark. It's rumored to have been made from cloth that was previously interred.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.sacred_hazard_helm: A hardy helm to help those hunting for slimes.
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t3: Help us test this new content.
helptips.properties|m.atg_cblocks: Hit a CRYSTAL BLOCK to destroy other crystal blocks of the same color.
help.properties|m.controls_options: You can change your current control scheme from the Options menu.
support.properties|m.delete_mail: Deleted mail from knightId\:{0} with subject "{1}".
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_5a: Along the north wall here we have all sorts of blocks, switches, doors, and buttons from the Clockworks. If you want to overcome the devious and deadly mechanisms down there I suggest you become familiar with how these work\!
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.nether_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when it is unleashed upon your foes.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...returning as something unnatural... 

...endless inferno.... 

...Almire destroyed... 

...they can never leave, they can never escape the flames...
item.properties|f.golden_solstice_ring: An enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its glittering golden luster shines brightest during the summer months.
item.properties|f.budding_helm: This cracked biotech helm is home to a harmless decorative plant.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I promoted myself to Senior Manager of Ghastly Implements of Destruction.
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Purchase a Krogmo Coin Booster from the Upgrades Merchant\!
item.properties|f.emberbreak_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against fire, at the expense of freeze and shock resistance.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll help any way I can, Pembrooke.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_3: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 4 Star gear and receive certification
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 3 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
chat.properties|m.usage_set_rank: Usage\: /{0} rank subrank\nSet your rank and subrank.
item.properties|f.bucket_of_flawed_snowb: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of Flawed Snowballs. Unfortunately, they will start to melt when exposed, so you better use them fast\!
item.properties|f.azure_guardian_armor: A grand set of armor commonly donned by the leaders of the Spiral Order. It's extraordinarily thick and protective, but as comfortable to wear as flowing miracloth.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_12: I admire your courage but if initial reports of this construct monster are accurate, you'll need some additional help. I'll prepare a selection of battle sprites to be ready for bonding to you, {0}. We'll talk again once I've made the proper preparations.
item.properties|f.super_dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more Dark Matter. How much Dark Matter is too much? This much.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_3a: Once again the sprites have changed and this time they're really creeping me out\!
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_2a: I bet. I guess you'll have to fill me in for once\!
item.properties|f.crown_fallen: A cursed crown once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_shield: A mythical shield imbued with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. It's said that the beast can use the glowing orbs on the shield's face to see and stalk weak-hearted wielders.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_gr: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a green glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.prize_box_raiders: Contains one of various unique items and accessories for raiders. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3c: Once you reach Haven I would advise you explore the town and familiarize yourself with all the sights and services the town has to offer. You will gain access to more powerful gear than we offer here as well and be surrounded with many more experienced knights. Be sure to ask them for assistance if you get lost.
item.properties|f.trojan_helm: A helm of the stalwart Spiral Wardens that is said to give great comfort to other knights.  Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_2a: Yes, I see that we're already back to-
item.properties|f.clockworks_armor: Forged from girders, gears, scrap, and pipes found in the Clockworks. Walk the catwalk... wearing the catwalk\!
item.properties|f.budding_coat: A ripped clean suit can mean death, but fortunately this one was colonized by an unusual symbiotic plant. Wear this and you'll be guaranteed to have a green thumb\!
item.properties|f.nodeslime_helm: A menacing mask of malice made from obliterated ominous ooze.
guild.properties|log.mist_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It's difficult to breathe in, but it can resist high temperatures and any number of savage attacks.
item.properties|f.breach_blaster: An enhanced pierce blaster designed to break through hostile armor.
item.properties|f.sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
mission.properties|r.collector_prisoner_: Can you make it back to Haven?
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A helm of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: Well met\! When I heard they were sending you {0}, I didn't believe it. THE Vanquisher of Vanaduke\! It's an honor to be reporting to you.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_1a: Thank you, Lieutenant. Any more information with regard to the Alpha Squad?
mission.properties|o.axes_of_evil: Stop the gremlin logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley
item.properties|f.irontech_destroyer: The big brother of the Irontech Bomb, the Destroyer unleashes the full potential of irontech power.
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of liquid flames that split on impact.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rooster: Contains various unique items to celebrate the year of the Rooster\! Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_medium: Advanced difficulty features an increased challenge for players who have a thorough grasp of combat. Monsters can deal and receive more damage and traps are more dangerous. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are increased.
item.properties|f.token_grim: A small wisp of the essential spirit of darkness and decay. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.spike_shower: A powerful device designed to shred opponents with a snarl.
mission.properties|m.a_call_to_arms1: This is Vaelyn at the Core Terminal. Team wiped out. Darkness everywhere. Send help. It is opening.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_2a: Yikes, are those the sprites or some kind of phantom?
mission.properties|o.great_escape: Infiltrate the gremlin prison, free the captured Knights and stage an escape
item.properties|f.storm_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride the lightning into battle.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro4_1a: I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp to the north. \n\nAnd should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
uplink.properties|i.crystal: The amount of energy to attach.
item.properties|f.dusker_coat: A warm adventurer's coat that'll let you strike with the ferocity of an Alpha Dusker.
social.properties|m.they_already_played: {0} has already completed this mission today.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3a: The Clockworks are the massive complex of gears and machinery that lies just below the surface of this whole world. It's truly an incredible sight. It is a strange and dangerous world in which we have found ourselves. Tread carefully.
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft3:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, intel has located a black kat nest beyond an area with electrifying resistance. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_4a: Yes, I feel the same way.  We owe it to them to put an end to this gremlin threat as quickly as possible. \n\nI've lined up several missions for you that will take you to locations where gremlins seem to be gathering resources for Project R.  Your briefing should explain everything.
item.properties|f.misplaced_promissory_n: An old document promising to pay a sum at a date long gone. Grants Normal Defense and increased Defense with decreased health.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Two cannons have stopped firing\!  Report at once, you mongrels\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_statustraps: Beware\!  Some traps can cause damage AND inflict harmful status effects.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant: Usage\: /{0} number\nGives you a number of crowns.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_3: Attack a mineral column in order to break it down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.lockbox_character: A special lockbox that contains one of many unique items that modify the appearance of your Knight\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2d: I've got no other questions, I'll be off.
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_helm: A commemorative helm that pays tribute to the countless brave Isoran guardians that have protected spacefaring crews in their adventures across the stars.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_mail: Thick armor reinforced with more metal plates than a Clockworks vending machine. It's a little uncomfortable.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3c: Most of them will attack you on sight, but there are some; outcasts from the colony, that have taken refuge in the towns below the surface. Theirs is a hard life, hated by their own kind and no longer in a world they call home.
uplink.properties|m.tf2_end:
To Whom It May Concern\: 

I have confirmed your arrival at the Clockworks Terminal, and have obtained the relevant data regarding our competitor's catalog. Mann Co. appreciates your cooperation in this task. 

In return for your assistance, we have remitted to you one (1) Mann Co. Brand "Spiral Sallet" replica headwear. No refunds or exchanges will be offered for this reward, and Mann Co. is not liable for any injury sustained while attempting to use said reward. 

Regards, 

Mister Reddy 
Mann Co. 
"We sell products and get in fights." 

The information in this mail is confidential and is intended solely for the addressee. Access to this mail by anyone else is unauthorized. If you are not an intended recipient, you must not read, use, think about, eat or seduce the information contained in this mail. Failure to comply with this request will result in the recipient being mauled by bears to within the fullest extent of the law.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_3a: Exactly, and they're worse now.  And the same goes for the undead.  You'll find that howlitzers become particularly bothersome with their enhanced firing and homing capabilities. \n\nLastly, prepare for fiend and undead monsters to potentially deal pure shadow damage.  As always, choose the right gear for the job should you want to live long enough to hear from me again.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_efbf39: Hit an opponent with a snowball in Lockdown.
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: One of them lobbed a spike at me\!
mission.properties|r.pioneers_8a: Tell me about Squad Technician Rulen.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_steam_cont: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
item.properties|f.sulfur: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
item.properties|f.drake_scale_mail: Armor forged from the scales of beasts thought to be the descendants of dragons.
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_helm: A sturdy helm designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
item.properties|m.box_variant: On the side, very small markings seem to read "{0}".
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_armor: A suit of armor worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: Don't know how long before our forcefield gives out...
conversation.properties|m.seerus_1: Is it power you seek? The fury of a burning star bound in steel? I will show you both\!
dungeon.properties|m.no_revive: Your revive effort is no longer necessary.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_helm: A finely-made helmet for the more discerning explosives expert. It won't tell you what kind of wine goes best with Nitronome, but it'll certainly keep your head looking good. And in one piece.
mission.properties|o.vicious_viscous: Prove your valor against a legion of powerful piercing monsters
item.properties|f.royal_skewer: A jagged, razor-sharp barb from one of the most powerful slimes on Cradle. Once removed from the slime it grows brittle and eventually turns to dust.
item.properties|f.cosmic_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_securi: Please check that the CVC or CVV security code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.airbraker_shield: A lightweight, compact, and pneumatically-activated shield that expands its surface area against enemy attacks.
item.properties|f.neutralizer: You'd be surprised at the number of practical applications to be had from two substances that, when combined, leave quite literally nothing in their wake. Neutralizer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.feral_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. Even the sharpest wolver claws merely glance off this compact carapace.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_5a: I'll stay here and protect these sprites. Some of these sprite transport crates are empty. I think someone or something is after them. \n\nYou go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.radiant_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within is wild and mysterious, shining brighter than any natural fire.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_7a: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_coat: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
item.properties|f.acheron: Striking with the savage power of the Underworld, this dark weapon has been known to drive weak-minded knights to the brink of madness.
mission.properties|r.winterfest_danger_1: I need all the help I can get, tell me all you know.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surge: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Surge style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
lottery.properties|m.lottery_announcemen: In {0}, a Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway drawing will be held amongst all online players for a prize of {1}\!
item.properties|f.toy_box: Contains one unique toyland costume or accessory. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
help.properties|m.monster_slime: Deal PIERCING - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against PIERCING
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: No problem, from the top then...
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: Thank you, Lieutenant, I'll head on into Haven.
item.properties|f.obsidian_shard: A jet-black shard of unnatural stone. Holding it fills your head with imagery of a distant shore where waves crash against rocks that seem to writhe in the chill of the water.
item.properties|f.proto_bomb: A small bomb used by Spiral Knight recruits to learn the art of blowing things up.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_danger: The Grinchlins have sabotaged Winterfest for the last time. Take the fight to them\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_zombie_bellh: A bellhop with unusual dedication in charge of carrying luggage to a guest's quarters. Most just offer to carry the bags themselves.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_2: Those heavy cogs are in our way, and from intel reports, the only way to open them up is from inside two adjacent gatehouses.  I will not waste needless lives battering at the gatehouse from the front.  I'll need you to find a way around.  Flank the defenses, get inside the gatehouse, and open up the gates\!
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello, Lieutenant.  How can I help you?
item.properties|f.shadow_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_3a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.scrap_metal: A discarded piece of metal that could be easily repurposed.
item.properties|f.freezing_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a dense cloud of extremely frigid mist.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Apologies for not appearing in person. I'm hidden away in a safe place. I knew I'd never make it there in time when I noticed your signal. Luckily I was able to pull some strings and find you an exit.

The rest of us thought we weren't going to make it. But then...then the light surrounded us and we were safe. We've taken to calling it The Sleeper. We aren't sure what it is exactly, but it needs our help. This world was created to protect it but somehow The Swarm breached the Core and has been feeding on the energy and growing like a leech ever since.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Did you see the view from the Arcade?
dungeon.properties|m.royal_jelly_desc: The Royal Jelly Palace is an ancient castle overtaken by a legion of slime monsters. It is unclear what purpose the castle serves, though it is rumored to house a Royal Jelly, said to be nobility within the slime kingdoms. If true then the purpose of the castle is likely to serve the Royal Jelly, and nothing more.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_stri: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_2: You nasty, little things\! Don't you dare touch the artifact\! \n\nArgh\! I'll be back for you\!
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
item.properties|f.volt_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful volt bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.lockdown_recon_shield: A highly advanced device used by Recon Specialists of the Spiral Order that renders the user nearly invisible to the naked eye.
item.properties|f.frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. Since it's made of cake, it eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_1a: {0}\! I hear they've selected you to save the day, eh?  Well, before you get all 'hero' on me and go marching off into the darkness below why don't you and I go head on over to the other side of the camp and teach a few of the monsters that tore up this camp last night a lesson?
item.properties|f.grand_flourish: A fanciful blade for those who prefer to solve their problems with a hop, a skip and a stab.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2c: Are there any friendly gremlins within the Clockworks?
mission.properties|m.search_continues_2a: The recon module you collected is very strange.  I have no reason to believe what Parma was saying isn't true, but how it happened I just can't say.  Everything about the Core suggests there are no 'doors' into it.  It's not a structure built to enter from the outside.  Rather, it seems just the opposite.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_e: I can feel the electricity in the air\!  Looks like we won't be making our final stand tonight after all\!
item.properties|f.eye_pack_bedazzling: Contains three bedazzling eye shapes for your style kit\: Flower, Blooming, and Sparkle.
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder_crims:
Infiltrate the Complex. 
Take all schematics. 
The Nine are quiet but we will silence them. 
The Knights pursue but we will halt them. 

Only Herex comprehends the Truth. Only Herex will descend. 
There can be no other.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Roarmulus Twins \nThese giant gun puppies showcase impenetrable armor and high powered munitions. Their skin is so thick they are only vulnerable to fraternal firepower.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_go: A festive fall snipe that will explore its surroundings.
item.properties|f.plate_shield: A heavy iron shield adept at deflecting impacts that would otherwise leave you stunned.
sprites.properties|d.no_mercy: Increases the damage inflicted by hexing haze.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r4: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  I hear you've recently arrived in Haven from across the great chasm.  While you were out there, did you encounter any of our battle sprites?
mission.properties|b.true_champion: Having come out of the Firestorm Citadel alive, Intel Agent Kora eagerly awaits to hear from you.
item.properties|f.ice_axe: A technical climbing tool that can pick apart monsters with precision.
conversation.properties|r.fc_bridge_2: I'm not here to make trouble with Vanaduke.
craft.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.toxic_catalyzer: A Catalyzer modified to fire dangerously radioactive projectiles. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a mecha knight.  It's so convincing, your friends just might try to deconstruct you\!
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_1: Show me who is up for adoption\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_construct: Contains various unique Construct-themed costumes and items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.grinchlin_snowball: Handcrafted by the grouchy Grinchlins of Mount Krampus, these repugnant projectiles are sure to put a damper on any Winterfestivities.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_3: These shelters will offer you two choices\: exit the mountain and claim some Grinchlin treasure, or press on further up the mountain. \n\nShould you press on, you pass on the loot in that shelter, but will find even more treasures at the next shelter.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r6: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
projectx.properties|m.enqueued: Please be patient; we are currently experiencing high server load.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2a: What happened here? These remains look to be hundreds of years old...
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_2: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Though it very much resembles the original, it is still missing pieces.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_armor: A variegated veiling ward worn by vehemently venerated victors.
item.properties|f.coliseum_room: A lively room featuring a Coliseum ticket booth, a Coliseum Rewards Supervisor, and a Krogmo Alchemy Machine.
guild.properties|m.invite_pending: {0} has already been invited to join your guild.
item.properties|f.irontech_bomb: A heavy bomb wrapped in thick iron plates. Though it is slower than most bombs, it packs a powerful punch.
item.properties|f.divine_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
mission.properties|o.new_threat: Confront a dangerous new threat to Haven
item.properties|f.chaos_cowl: A hood of dubious origin that shrouds its wearer in both mystery and elemental protection.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_3a: We have pinpointed its location to be in the deepest level of a gremlin facility known as the 'Ironclaw Munitions Factory.'  The factory is used for the production of all manners of gremlin weaponry and is highly dangerous, even to the gremlins working there. \n\nYou must prepare yourself for heavy resistance from shock-powered constructs and gremlins.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
item.properties|f.firebreak_helm: An Emberbreak Helm modified to provide further protection against fire.
guildhelp.properties|m.design_info: Design Mode allows a guild member of sufficient rank to rearrange the furniture and other infrastructure within a Guild Hall. Once in Design Mode, furniture items can be picked up and put back down again much like a Gold Key or Heavy Statue, and by default they can be rotated while held by using the Mouse Wheel. When you are happy with your rearranging, you can Publish your changes from the Command Console and make them visible to the rest of your guild.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: Hello there, {0}\!  My name is Bosco and I'm here to give you a rundown on the basics of alchemy. \n\nIt's pretty simple stuff really, thanks to these Alchemy Stations.  They do all the heavy lifting for ya\!
helptips.properties|m.tg3_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This last level will teach you the last few important things you will need to know as an explorer of the Clockworks. Head up the ramp and let's begin\!

mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
item.properties|f.capsule_remedy: A small capsule that refreshes its user. It can be used to remove all status conditions you're afflicted with.\n\nDon't panic\! Remedy capsules can be a life saver, if you remember to use them\!
uplink.properties|m.royal_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad within this palace.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Royal Jelly Palace is a strange place.  It appears to be some sort of castle that slimes have re-purposed as a residence for members of their oozing aristocracy.  Known as a 'Royal Jelly,' these noble slimes are said to rule over their countless loyal subjects with an iron fist-shaped appendage. 

Our intel suggests that the module is located somewhere near an enormous concentration of slimes, so it is reasonable to believe that it may be the 'throne room' of a Royal Jelly.  If so, be prepared for a fearsome fight- Royal Jellies are quick to anger and love to throw their enormous weight around.  Your best bet is to find a way to suppress their natural regenerative abilities. 

Good luck\!

item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_3: A perfect fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.

mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_5: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.

Many patrol the main drag, so watch your back as you move about.\n\nOnce you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. But that might prove difficult as they are quite a disagreeable lot.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\! Merry Winterfest\!

That special time of year is finally here, when a delicate blanket of wondrous white snow covers Haven and every Stranger, every snipe and every Knight fills their hearts with holiday cheer.

But to you I must tell, all is sadly not well. Lacking motive or reason, a group of shriveled-heart grinchlins have threatened this Winterfest season\!

mission.properties|b.rotting_metropolis: It would seem as though those slime generators have been around much longer than we thought, seeping their vile toxins into any levels that should be near them. \n\nA modern city, much like those that the devilites inhabit seems to be overrun with these toxins, and was probably left behind by both the devilites and gremlins as a result.  Now a legion of slime and undead creatures haunt the place, festering in the poisons that linger in the air.  A squad that was attempting to pass through the city has gone missing.  Given that the very air is toxic, it is urgent that an experienced team enter this city and rescue the squad.  There is little hope left for them otherwise.
