mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
helptips.properties|m.tut_switches: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch nearby. Have a look around. They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_helm: A hardy helm handcrafted by Gremlin smiths to protect a Mecha Knight's control unit. With the control unit removed it fits a knight remarkably well.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.green_ward: A sturdy shield with an emerald sheen that saves Spiral Knight recruits from the perils of sharp spikes and deadly toxins.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_ritua: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
item.properties|f.frenzy_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a flash of frenzy from the heavens.
item.properties|f.cosmic_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Welcome to the Moorcroft Archives, traveler. Here you will find an illustrious collection of ancient grimoires from many forgotten worlds. It's quite the sight, I know\! \n\nYou're free to look around but please don't touch- some of these books are filled with incredible mystic power. You could hurt yourself\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_obstacle: A baleful shield of obelisk fragments bound by Apocrean ritual. Every time the fragments align, dark memories echo in your mind.
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_2: Thanks Nonna, but maybe next time.
item.properties|f.crystal_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in an alloy of Moonstone and Valestone. Its soothing shade of cerulean has been clinically proven to both calm knights and annihilate the undead.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_11: I'll put an end to their scheme.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Snarbolax \nThe mythical Snarbolax is immune to knight attacks. Ringing the Beast Bell when it is nearby will stun the beast into submission.
conversation.properties|m.hav_snipes_2a: The snipes are the graceful, adorable, fetchingly-corpulent birds you see roaming about Haven. Some say they are the most beautiful creatures in the galaxy, but you would never hear that from the snipes themselves as they are incredibly modest.
chat.properties|m.usage_smile: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nSmile at your fellow players.
mission.properties|o.silent_legion: Pursue Guardian Knight Arkus and bring him back to Haven
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_4: Welcome back to the Hall of Heroes, {0}.  Please speak to the heroic knights you see before you to gain access to their weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.venom_veiler: The ultimate in toxic dispersal devices, the Venom Veiler can be used to destroy pests on crops. Failing that, it can also be used to destroy crops.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We were studying that meteorite when those lichens appeared\!
uplink.properties|m.autoprune: Note\: Mail is automatically deleted 30 days after sent date.
mission.properties|o.laboratory_visit: Visit the Lab and meet with Biotech Morlin
item.properties|m.accessory_multi: This accessory occupies two locations\: {0} and {1}.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_1: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a prototype version.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a crack shot warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
conversation.properties|m.mission_apocre: If you're going further, be on your guard. I smell a trap.
mission.properties|r.anniversary_gremlin: Biscotti asked me to come check on you.
helptips.properties|m.atg_ublocks: Some blocks cannot be destroyed by normal attacks.
item.properties|f.winter_pullover: A not-so-stylish sweater for the snowy season. The perfect pullover to embarass your family and guildmates alike.
item.properties|f.valestone: A fabled mineral of a vibrant, green color said to contain the essence of all natural life.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_4a: Yes, I can think of no greater tragedy.  Good luck then, {0}.
helptips.properties|m.pressure_pads: These special buttons will only trigger if something is holding them down. Try using that statue to hold one down.
mission.properties|o.pioneers: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
pvp.properties|m.coins_earned.1: You have earned {0} Krogmo Coin playing {1}\!
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.jelly_glue: A viscous compound developed by Biotechs to allow for the study of slime creatures. When mixed with slime and jelly matter, it allows for reshaping without losing its form. Though reserved for scientific purposes, the process is generally regarded as 'super fun.'
mission.properties|b.chilled_to_bone:
By now you have no doubt run into strange, undead monsters known as 'spookats.'  Recon Knights have finally discovered what seems to be the source of these ghostly cat-like creatures. 

Large concentrations of spookats have been sighted in what is believed to be the darkened remains of an owlite castle.  Dubbed the 'Candlestick Keep' this shadowy realm is only illuminated by a series of owlite candles.    

Proceed with caution while exploring outside the light of the candles.  Lurking in the dark are enormous spookats known as 'grimalkins.'  Grimalkins seem to withstand all weaponry and are to be avoided.  Your only defense is to stay in the light\! 

Spiral HQ has issued you this mission in order to collect more data on the origins of the spookats and the mystery behind the fall of the owlites.  Investigate the Candlestick Keep and report your findings\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_techknight: Good data is like a good pudding, you can never have too much of it.
projectx.properties|e.no_lead_node: Service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_1: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 1 star item.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.token_core: A fragment of strange material found within the core of the Clockworks. Each fragment seems to have an entirely unique composition, like snowflakes. These fragments are highly prized by Spiral HQ as they hope to learn the nature of the core through their study.
mission.properties|r.the_flickering_flam: That gremlin Herex must be involved.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.gun_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gun puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might give you the run around\!
pvp.properties|m.love_unapprove_confirm: Are you sure? You will be able to make changes again, but the approval process will be started over.
social.properties|m.booted: {0} has been banned from the party.
helptips.properties|m.controls: Press [[TOGGLE_HELP]] at any time to view the controls.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of dark matter.
pvp.properties|m.bribe_description: Everyone can pitch in to bribe King Krogmo. Fill the meter with energy to reveal a BONUS PRIZE\!
item.properties|f.shard_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in depleted Crimsonite. Depleted or not, this sucker can sling some serious shrapnel.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni: I see.  This will be very interesting information for Spiral HQ.  Our base camp in Haven is just up ahead.  Head on up the elevator and meet the other Knights who survived the crash like yourself. The techs in the Lab will be eager to study that artifact.  They'll see to it once you get to Haven. \n\nDon't worry about the others in the Rescue Camp.  Thanks to you, we have a functioning elevator system to reach them.  You've saved them all\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_mewkat: An adorable little spectral kitten that enjoys wandering around and mewing at just about everything it sees.
item.properties|f.raiders_axe: An ornate, fiery axe favored by raiders for its versatility.
item.properties|f.the_bitter_end: A shield carried by all members of the Recon Rangers. Its name is a reminder to all Rangers as to precisely when they are permitted to drop it in battle.
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc2: On success, you will be briefly disconnected.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_6a:
Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison. 

It would seem that Maulos, that horrible arch-fiend you just took down, had a different use in mind and was actually destroying this everfrost to unleash swarms of angry, frozen souls into the Clockworks.  Had he finished the job, well, I don't even want to think about how many sweaters we would all be needing right now...
helptips.properties|m.back_to_haven: This path will take you back to Haven if you are not able to enter the Fiend's Grim Gate.
projectx.properties|e.too_young: You must be at least 13 to play Spiral Knights.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: Some of your {0} friends already have a full friend list\:\n{1}\n{2}
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: Did you come from the chasm?  How?
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r9: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
item.properties|f.volcanic_iron: An extraordinary metal imbued with the blazing energy of magma.
pvp.properties|m.watch_nogames: No games of this type are currently available to watch.
chat.properties|m.usage_level: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [level]\nSets the equipment to that level.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_3a: One was clearly not enough last time... so now there are two\! TWO\! Brilliant\!
mission.properties|o.darkest_depths: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.vial_curse_ultra: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: I have faith in you, {0}.  I just know that you will be among the select Knights skillful enough to reach the Core and with any luck, get us off this planet.
item.properties|f.raging_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so angry, his rage alone could fell armies that rose against him.
item.properties|f.winter_grave: A tremendously powerful hand cannon whose moniker should come as no surprise to anyone who happens to be viewing it from the wrong end. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Take cover if you get overwhelmed\!
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_message: You were awarded Krogmo Coins for participation in {0}\!
item.properties|f.brute_core: An oozing blue lump from a particularly potent gelatinous opponent.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3b: Energy is used for all sorts of things\! It's the primary currency for buying goods from the Supply Depot, it allows you to purchase upgrades for yourself, revive yourself in the Clockworks when you run out of Sparks of Life, and it's required to form a guild. \n\nYou'll also find all sorts of devices in the world that are powered up by using energy. Just look for the blue energy symbol on the device.
social.properties|m.already_invited: {0} has already been invited to your party.
item.properties|f.coin_bonus_upgrade_1: Once used, this upgrade will increase Coins earned in Coliseum games by 1 for 24 hours.  You may have up to 6 Krogmo Coin Boosters active at any time.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_5a: In the mean time we'll run an analysis on that strange device you found in the Royal Jelly Palace. If it is related to the Artifact, we'll find out soon enough\! \n\nGood luck, {0}.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_3a: And why is it now blocking access to the Core, now that we're so close?
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder: Schemer Razwog\: Work away from the others. The Order must never know we have the artifact. Find a way to power it. Bring it to me. Do not betray me.  I will know. \n\n-H
global.properties|e.invalid_xfer_state: An error has been detected with your knight. Please log off and back on again. If the problem persists, please file a bug report.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gremlin: Contains various unique costumes and items crafted by Gremlins. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|b.go_shopping_b: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found. However, there seems to be some kind of commotion just outside the normally bustling marketplace. It looks like there is no time to waste; there is trouble brewing\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_2: Yes, exactly\! During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
item.properties|f.confetti_summer: When thrown, this summer confetti makes you feel all warm inside.
dungeon.properties|m.revive_member: Revive using a Spark of Life ({0})
exchange.properties|m.steam_success: Thank you for your purchase\! Your Energy will be delivered momentarily.
monster.properties|m.promotion_2: We could use a guy like you in management.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_plump_gobble: An impressively-large gobble snipe that is taking a nice, long rest after a hearty meal.
item.properties|m.sprite_material_and_fo: Can be fed to Battle Sprites or used to craft Battle Sprite food.
item.properties|f.gm_helmet: An impressive indigo helmet that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_1:
The Hall of Heroes is where knights go to receive their Star Certification allowing them to access deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Each certification ensures a knight meets the star level required to deal with challenges in the upcoming missions. 

The Hall of Heroes also allows knights the opportunity to speak to veteran knights and discover their loadouts, even offering the opportunity to purchase recipes for these loadouts. 

Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification in order to obtain access to missions within deeper levels of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.spur: A mechanized sword with a built in motor that generates energy bursts when used.
item.properties|f.wicked_whisker: A whisker won from the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel. They were traditionally worn as a ward against Owlite magics but now represent the triumph of goodly magical arts over evil.
conversation.properties|m.tier_2_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 7-1. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_1: Hello. I'm Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark and head of geological studies within the Clockworks.
mission.properties|o.whipping_mishandlin: Deliver the supplies to the research team within the fiendish city of Sol' Fork
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_2: In order to venture even deeper within the Clockworks you must once again visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 3 Star Certification.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_2c: What lies at the core of the Clockworks?
item.properties|f.sacred_shade_helm: A helm built to outlast whatever might slink from the shadows.
item.properties|f.jar_o_fireflies: A small jar of hibernating fireflies that can be released on a festive occasion.
item.properties|f.cautery_sword: A sword adapted from a medical tool, its heated blade reduces tissue damage. It is very formidable at destroying monsters of the slime family.
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: Power has come surging back to the camp\!  You did it, {0}\!
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mask: A mask said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. The shattered ice will conceal your identity during clandestine arctic expeditions.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_suit: A special suit built to commemorate Isoran starfarers of old.  With this equipped, you feel like you would never get lost in space... if only the Skylark could fly.
conversation.properties|r.fountain_1: Thanks for the information, I'm off to explore\!
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_2a: Yes, we nature sprites are the rain, the root, and the soil. But you are not like us. You are like the ones below.
item.properties|f.voltaic_tempest: This high-tech, high voltage device is not recommended for use in water, around water, or near people thinking about water. To be safe, you probably shouldn't look at it, either.
dungeon.properties|m.dark_city_desc: This once bustling city from an advanced world is now home to innumerable fiends from the Underworld. Under the light of the moon they burn their dark sigils into the ground, summoning more of their cohorts for reasons yet unknown.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_7a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.prize_box_hazardous: Contains various unique items used by Rhendon's elite Scarlet Scouts. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
guild.properties|log.member_added: Accepted {0}'s invitation to join the guild. Welcome\!
board.properties|i.joinparty: Join a party already in progress.
item.properties|f.cracked_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. Though cracked, it still glows ever so faintly.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_5: I've been talking with Spiral HQ about it now for some time and they're prepared to investigate it further.  Though I don't think I'll be changing their mind about trying to open the Core any time soon.  That's still priority number one for now. \n\nAll I can say is be careful out there, {0}.  I think this world has more surprises in store for us than we know.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_4a: That's the kind of spirit I like to see. Continue to complete missions for Spiral HQ as they are assigned to you. With your help we stand a chance at reaching the Core and saving Isora.
item.properties|f.celestial_vortex: A Celestial Bomb modified with a payload of a dying sun. Foes caught in its fiery blast radius are shown a glimpse of the dawn of creation.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_ma: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! Unfortunately, that knight already has a full friend list, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
item.properties|f.elite_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Orbs like these are used by elite knights to craft items of exceptional quality and power.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_4a: Tell me about Squad Leader Euclid.
item.properties|f.impostoclaus_hat: A fabulously festive Winterfest hat that makes the wearer look like the great spirit of Winterfest, Impostoclaus. Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\!
conversation.properties|m.ritual_4a: Well, that was unexpected. I'll get it right next time\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_12b: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you out.  Good luck and remember that I'll always be here to keep your armor looking unique\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I don't think anyone will notice I'm missing.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_giantswor: Etched within the side of the blade appears to be some kind of map of the stars.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_3a: Well, keep your wits about you. If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Biotech Hahn for research.
item.properties|f.prize_box_blooming: Contains various unique costumes and accesories to celebrate the blooming nature of spring.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.ultra_shock_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_armor: A phantasmal suit of armor for those who are aiming for the infernal.
uplink.properties|t.newsletter: Subscribe to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
item.properties|f.lockbox: A special lockbox that contains one of hundreds of unique items\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
item.properties|f.fur_cap: A toasty fur cap forming the visage of a wild beast.
projectx.properties|m.logoff_required: This change will cause you to log off and reconnect.
item.properties|f.magnus: A large handgun with hard hitting rounds that can leave even the strongest of monsters dazed. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
projectx.properties|m.spritelocked: SPRITE LOCKED\: Battle Sprites can be equipped, fed and skill points assigned in towns or at Arsenal Stations.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat_snow: A holiday hat so festive, snow falls above it\!  Fortunately for the wearer, the hat itself is super warm.
chat.properties|m.usage_advance: Usage\: /{0} [number of floors]\nAdvances the party ahead one or more floors.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_2a: First dragons and now... little winged feline creatures? I can't believe we're seeing this phenomenon again\!
item.properties|f.chilling_duelist: Start settling disputes at the crack of dawn with this cold, custom handgun.
item.properties|f.spiral_brigandine: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_super: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak_vol: A scorched feathered cloak. Set a fire under your feet and ensure punctuality as sure as the roosters crow.
mission.properties|o.ending_in_fire: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r7: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
help.properties|m.controls_attack: [[ACTION]]. Hold to do a charge attack. [[ACTION]] also lifts large items, speaks to NPCs, and activates stations.
item.properties|f.box_elite_trinket: Contains various elite, five-star trinkets and a Trinket Slot Upgrade. Items are randomly chosen. No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_spec: Hi there {0}, I'm Zebulon, a knight who utilizes specialty gear that is suited for specific scenarios.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons that target specific monster families and gear that has mixed defense types. \n\nSometimes what you really need is a sword that smites the undead or armor that raises your slime smashing proficiency.  The gear I specialize in is often built for a specific task, but is also great to mix and match with other sets.  Experiment\!
item.properties|f.super_shard_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more depleted Crimsonite. The choicest cure for a combative creature is clearly a crystal to the cranium.
support.properties|m.option_1_0: 1. Remember you can click on players and choose "Ignore" to block any chat and mail from them. Click here to ignore {0} and skip the complaint.
item.properties|f.spoiled_treat: A terrible tummy ache awaits those who partake in the fetid fare of Winterfest past.
item.properties|f.frozen_great_cleaver: A custom made Triglav designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
item.properties|m.use_change_color: Use your {0} to change your personal color?
item.properties|f.kat_eye_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Seekers, the skillful grenadiers of the Kat Tribe.
sprites.properties|d.valkyrian_aura: Party members within the protective aura gain a charge speed bonus.
helptips.properties|m.tg_welcome: Welcome to the Training Ground, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: {0}, you've already done so much for all of us but I must now ask you to make one final sacrifice. We might never have a chance to return home to Isora, but right now Cradle needs us. I would like you to spearhead our Operations on Cradle.
item.properties|f.furni_bed_spiralmilita: A comfy cot that's better than bunking in a bedroll.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_2_6a: What have they become this time?
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard {0}. Kora said you had news of the Alpha Squad. Please, give us your report.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_heat: You may have noticed monsters leaving little embers like these behind. Embers grant you heat. As your heat meter fills, the flame next to your health will grow. If you make it to the exit without dying, the heat will be applied to your weapons and armor. Over time, this will level them up and make them stronger. While playing with others, every party member gets heat whenever anyone picks up an ember.
conversation.properties|m.guard_laborato: I'm sorry, {0}, you are not authorized to enter the lab yet.
item.properties|f.boater: A stylish skimmer to sport at summer soirees.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r3: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
mission.properties|b.high_temperature_ho:
Intel had reported a gremlin deconstruction crew dismantling a portion of the Clockworks in order to generate scrap resources for use in their Project R. Using powerful welding torches, they are truly burning the place to the ground. 

One of the squads investigating the site has gone missing and is believed to be now held in captivity at the site. 

Infiltrate the fiery deconstruction zone and rescue the captive knights.  But be warned, the deconstruction crew are said to have a powerful security construct hidden somewhere on site.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_4a: As a Defender, you can now undertake missions in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  These are the deepest and most dangerous depths of the Clockworks, delve any further and you will reach the Core itself. \n\nPerhaps if you make it that far, you can locate the Alpha Squad, I just don't know.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_suit: An advanced demolitions suit capable of resisting the strongest sleep mists. The soft glow is strangely stimulating.
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_fiel: A sturdy Spiral scanner that assembles in minutes, provides hours of intel, and lasts for years.
social.properties|e.maxfriends_inviter: Sorry, {0} already has the maximum number of friends.
item.properties|f.exp_west_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Right.  Spiral HQ has informed me you'll likely be facing hordes of gremlins and constructs on this next go around.  Keep in mind that in Tier 3, these monsters can inflict pure elemental damage.  Do be sure to gear up appropriately.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_4a: Energy is essential in order to acquire powerful gear and items from the Supply Depot. \n\nYou will find all sorts of uses for it in your travels, just look for the energy symbol\!
mission.properties|o.shocking_sentient_s: Battle your way to the secret weapons facility
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the price, in crowns, that you are willing to pay.
chat.properties|m.usage_admin: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all admins.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones can move in a few different ways.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r3: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_3b: Thank you for your help. When I am ready, I will enter the final gate.
item.properties|f.prize_box_nemesis: Contains various unique items representing good and evil. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
chat.properties|m.usage_helpme: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you need help\!
chat.properties|m.talk_self: Talking to yourself is a sign of insanity.
mission.properties|b.terminal_meltdown: Drawn to the Firestorm Citadel, a horde of fiery slime and beast monsters have swarmed a nearby fuel depot putting the depot and our access to the citadel at risk. Should these monsters spread the fires into the fuel drums, the whole place will go up in flames. \n\nSpiral HQ needs you to enter the depot and put out the fire before time runs out and an explosive disaster is triggered\!
social.properties|m.friend_party_full: Oops\! {0}'s party is no longer accepting new members.
item.properties|f.forbidden_fruit: A sinful snack favored by famished fiends.
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium perfect for pondering over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore.
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Spiral HQ has us investigating reports that pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter are appearing all over the Clockworks. Kora believes the Fiends are up to something. There is evidence they played a hand in the disappearance of the tortodrones.
helptips.properties|m.tut_jelly_cubes: Look out\! Up ahead is a pack of wild jellycubes. When you are close enough, you will automatically target the nearest monster. They will be illuminated with a light column.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r9: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
helptips.properties|m.loading5: You can see what your friends are up to by clicking on the social button in the bottom left corner of your screen. You can even instantly join them if there is room in their party.
guildhelp.properties|l.treasury_console: The Guild Treasury can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
sprites.properties|d.caustic_quills: Fires a series of quills that stick to targets and inflict poison. For each hit a quilled target receives, they lose one quill and take additional damage.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_1: A ceremonial shield issued to Spiral Knight recruits. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_2a: If you know where it is, I'll put a stop to it.
helptips.properties|m.new_sprite: You've got a battle sprite\! Press [[SPRITE_ACTION_1]] to use your sprite's battle skill\!
item.properties|f.spark_life: A powerful charge of pure energy that instantly revives you or a fellow party member.
projectx.properties|m.mission_imf: Recover the recon module in the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
mission.properties|b.rise_or_fall: Infiltrating the Royal Jelly Palace and taking on the hordes of slimes that serve the great Royal Jelly is not going to be an easy task.  It is highly recommended you seek one of the 'Battle Arenas' within the Clockworks and determine if your equipment is up to the challenge of facing so many savage slimes. \n\nSpiral HQ has located one of these mysterious arenas that seems to be filled with all manner of gooey gladiators seeking a challenge.  Give them a good fight\!
projectx.properties|m.name_in_use: Sorry, that name is already in use.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_shield: A small, spooky shield to safeguard you from shadow.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skbedrol: A soft sleeping bag perfect for whenever you're "roughing it". For a Spiral Knight stranded on Cradle, this is most of the time.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_hoo: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_6a: Good luck to you. Travel swiftly and avoid their grasp.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r9: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
pvp.properties|e.late_playagain: You are too late to play again.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_4a: Piercing damage is produced by slime and beast family monsters. Additionally, slime monsters tend to be weak to shadow damage and beasts themselves to piercing damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_2: As your shield absorbs damage it will turn from green to red and eventually break. Once it's broken you cannot defend until it regenerates, so be careful\!
mission.properties|r.anniversary_start_3: Though my training never included confectionery combat, I'm in\!
item.properties|f.furni_bench_manor: An exquisite bench, perfect for perching in plush repose.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_or: A short torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
item.properties|f.stoic_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_1a: We meet again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has asked me to introduce you to some advanced alchemy.  Don't worry, this won't take long.  I've got an old mecha knight to work on anyway.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
item.properties|f.prize_box_moorcroft: Contains various unique Moorcroft Manor-themed furnishings. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.mercurial_mail: A supreme set of silver armor that'll put a spring in your step while keeping shocks out of it.
item.properties|f.shrouded_crest: Blackened, cursed, and hidden from sight. Thrice-damned herald of an ill-fated soul.
item.properties|m.equip_locked: Equipping {0} will bind it to you. You will not be able to trade this item once bound. Are you sure?
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_2a: Go. I will allow you to have one last moment before I destroy your meddling kind. However, should you choose to turn down my generous offer then you are welcome to come and face me in the Core where I will hasten your demise.
dungeon.properties|m.battle_arena_1: Battle Arena|Fight for Glory, Fight for Treasure
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r3: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_5a: Thank you Kora, I'll try to find a way across the chasm to Haven.
mission.properties|o.minerals_rock: Report to Chief Geo Knight Wegner in the Haven Arcade
item.properties|f.sentenza: An ancient handgun forged from shadow steel. It is said to have been wielded by an evil one who possessed "angel eyes."
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_0_1a: Well met, {0}. This is the Hall of Heroes, where veteran knights come to offer their services to members of our order who have attained the rank of Soldier or higher. \n\nBy undertaking more missions, I am confident that you will one day stand among us.
invite.properties|m.description_invitati: Invite a friend to come join you in\nSpiral Knights\!\nFill in their e-mail address and we'll send them an invitation to join.
conversation.properties|m.casino_klepto_: I won't steal anything... I promise\!
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_2a: I've read your report of the Core, it's fascinating.  What an impossible structure and to think that the Alpha Squad might actually still be alive but... inside that thing is just incredible. \n\nI understand that Lieutenant Vaelyn has already led a team to the Core terminal and is establishing a base of operations for research.  This is of great value to all Spiral Knights and we have you to thank\!
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_3: Thanks {0}, I appreciate it.  And do me a favour, please don't mention this little 'incident' to Spiral HQ...
guild.properties|i.buy_environments: Change the environment for the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r9: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.

item.properties|f.eye_pack_amazing: Contains three amazing eye shapes for your style kit\: Clover, Skull, and Circuitry.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r9: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.

item.properties|f.shako: A ceremonial cap worn by knights during highly prestigious occasions.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_3a: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap. \n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
helptips.properties|m.tut_dash: Evade damage from monster attacks by pressing [[DODGE]].
projectx.properties|d.achievement_a86a6d: Defeat the fabled Snarbolax that lives deep within the Gloaming Wildwoods.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
mission.properties|r.prestigious_opportu: Thank you, Kora.  I'll do my best.
pvp.properties|m.no_reward: You have dishonored my great Coliseum with your lack of fighting spirit\!  You shall receive no Krogmo Coins and no rank points\!
helptips.properties|m.candlestick_keep: Beware the horrible Grimalkins that lurk in the dark\!  These cursed wraiths cannot be destroyed and the only thing they truly fear is the light of the enchanted candles.  Light them with embers and take refuge in their shining embrace.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_1b: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.

conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Good luck in there, we know you can do it\!

item.properties|f.padded_demo_suit: An upgraded suit for bombers that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.

mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.
helptips.properties|m.tg_doors: Doors can be opened in many different ways.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_9a: Why yes, given their outward appearance I think 'maskeraith' suits them nicely\!
item.properties|f.blizzbreaker_shield: A reliable shield that'll prevent your foes from keeping you on ice.

item.properties|f.meteor_mote: A small piece of a rare material that is said to have fallen from the sky. Gremlins typically use it in the construction of power sources.

sprites.properties|d.deadly_shadow_cloak: Gain an attack power and attack speed bonus when shadow cloak activates. Bonus lasts for a short duration after shadow cloak expires.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_super: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
item.properties|f.beach_hat: A head-mounted personal portable lightweight shade structure.
chat.properties|m.usage_reboot: Usage\: /{0} minutes message\nSchedules a server reboot.
mission.properties|b.becoming_champion: Having heard of your many accomplishments and successful missions completed for Spiral HQ, Lieutenant Feron would like to speak with you.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_8a: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Tucked away inside a mysterious garden we found a strange portal that HQ is calling a Grim Gate. From what we were able to decode you will need a key of sorts to open it. Spiral HQ thinks the glyphs we spotted the Fiends carrying might have something to do with opening the gate.
item.properties|f.leviathan_blade: A rare treasure of the Spiral Order, the blows from this mythical sword are said to rain down upon its victims like the water from a tidal wave.
item.properties|f.gigawatt_pulsar: A powerfully enhanced handgun that hits foes with the force of a lightning bolt. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
guild.properties|i.officer_storage: Community item storage for officers and above.
dungeon.properties|m.moorcroft_desc: A mysterious old manor home to a number of restless spirits. Moorcroft Manor appears to act as a station stop for spirits in their travels, however none of them appear to actually be going anywhere in particular.
pvp.properties|m.start_delayed: Your {0} game has been delayed. Waiting for more players...
mission.properties|b.first_contact_b: With the power restored to the Rescue Camp, you can now use your comlink to contact Spiral HQ and find out where they have located after the crash of the Skylark.  Once you have made contact with Spiral HQ you will hopefully find out what caused the crash and the nature of this alien world you now inhabit.
item.properties|f.supply_deluxe_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This deluxe pack has enough supplies to last an entire squad of Knights one week.
item.properties|f.red_shard: A shard of Crimsonite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_2: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 2 star item.
item.properties|f.owlite_feather: A small feather plucked from an Owlite, said to be a mythical race of great magician birds.
guild.properties|m.name_in_use: Sorry, that name is already in use.
item.properties|f.stone_tortoise: A large, powerful shield made to resemble a creature's shell. Its formidable weight can make attacking more difficult.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_4a: Looks like I need to get you up to speed.  We've crashed on a planet known as 'Cradle.'  Cradle is a fascinating world in that the entire interior of the planet below its surface is an ever-changing mechanical complex known as the 'Clockworks.' \n\nThe Clockworks seems to have been built by 'gremlins,' a furry race of malevolent monsters that have not taken kindly to our presence.
conversation.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: Great timing\! You're free and clear. Good luck\!
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_shield: A superior shield forged from sun silver. The meaning of the crest on its face has been lost to time.
item.properties|f.tri_guard_armor: A special suit of armor designed specifically for knights on first recon of alien planets. This rugged suit protects against a variety of harsh elements.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_5a: Nice to finally meet you in person, {0}\!  Congratulations\!
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_2a: Yes, it has become something of a second home for us hasn't it?  Almost like we belong here, it's strange.
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_mask: A mask said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. The internal gyros and shock crest are sure to obscure your identity.
item.properties|f.binding_essence: A strange, vile reagent thought to be harnessed by the Apocrea to build their structures. Once it gets on your skin it seems to never wash off. No, it must, you simply need to scrub harder. Harder, yes...
mission.properties|b.weight_of_darkness:
It is speculated that all fiends within the Clockworks crossed over from a dimension known as the Underworld.  While how they crossed over and what their motives are on Cradle is unclear, data collected from fiendish cities seems to indicate that they are now stranded on Cradle, much like us. 

The undead on the other hand remain a mystery.  Why spirits return to the material realm is unknown, though it is clear that many of the spirits within the Clockworks have come from other worlds.  Given how hostile these creatures can be, the only way to obtain useful data is through direct interactions, like combat. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you collect combat data for the powerful fiend and undead monsters in Tier 3 of the Clockworks in order to better understand the nature of these creatures. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with shadow resistant gear with elemental and piercing damage weapons\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_3: Thankfully the damage to the lab wasn't too extensive. The equipment for maintaining our battle sprites is intact at least.
guild.properties|log.mist_removed: Withdrew {0} mist energy from the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.fierce_flamberge: A scorching saber whose main thrust is to rotisserie your foes.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: That's just it {0}, nothing. We've been monitoring the base below for weeks then it went silent. Quite suddenly. We're not sure what you're going to find down there. Our sensors show no active life forms.
chat.properties|m.usage_zgo: Usage\: /{0} zone name\nMoves to the named zone.
item.properties|f.wolver_mask: A simple mask made from wolver pelt.
item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of photon-charged liquid that split on impact.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven_b: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next.
item.properties|f.firebreak_armor: Upgraded Emberbreak armor further hacked to resist fire.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against fire.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.great_defender_c: A well-crafted costume version of a classic shield.
exchange.properties|m.offertosell_toolti: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100.
item.properties|f.sallet: A streamlined helm favored by front line fighters.
item.properties|f.almire_table: A table transplanted from the hallowed halls of Almire to adorn your abode.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
mission.properties|o.ancient_generator: Explore the Ancient Generator and restore power to the Rescue Camp before night falls\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|b.search_continues: Lieutenant Vaelyn would like to thank you for opening up a path to the Core and allowing her to set up an on-site research base.
item.properties|f.lightning_capacitor: An upgraded Capacitor that can explode with the fury of an electrical storm.
item.properties|f.proto_shield: A small shield issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_3a: Wow, {0}, you seem to have a way with battle sprites\! Let's not waste any time. Clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
projectx.properties|m.equip_loadout_lock: There are unbound items in {0}. Equipping this loadout will automatically bind them. Are you sure?
mission.properties|m.pioneers_10a: Rulen was very... logical.  I think he was very aware of the odds we have of reaching the Core and then doing something with it in order to restore the Skylark.  I think Rulen knew exactly what kind of mission he was undertaking when they made their first descent into the darkness of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.flawed_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Though flawed, this orb is still useful in crafting low-powered items.
uplink.properties|m.auction_cancelled: Don't think twice next time, items just love being sold\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_7a: It's unclear, {0}. Given Rhendon's report, I'd say they learned something from the old arcane tomes you discovered near these sprites. Fascinating that they appear to have adapted their combat abilities because of this.
item.properties|f.dangerous_grim_mask: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of Death itself. Those that wear it have a saying, 'Death always watching, so you might as well put on a good show.'
