social.properties|m.party_invite: {0} has invited you to join their party.
item.properties|f.shadow_steel: An extraordinary metal imbued with the creeping darkness of the Underworld.
item.properties|m.exp_upkeep: This expansion will increase your Guild Hall's upkeep by {0} crowns.
mission.properties|b.shadowplay: Even after Lord Vanaduke's defeat at your hands, Firestorm Citadel continues to burn with accursed flames. Though the nature sprites have been steadily making progress in fighting the flames, something or someone has recently caused a violent resurgence in its destructive power. Spiral HQ requests that you gather together a crack squad of knights and return to the collapsing ruins of Firestorm Citadel in order to discover the source of the disturbance.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
projectx.properties|m.cs_instructions: Please select the control layout you would like to use.
item.properties|f.armor_fallen: A cursed suit of armor once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.reaper_rib: A bone stained black by the wickedness of its former possessor.
helptips.properties|m.can_resurrect: You have been granted a Spark of Life by a party member. Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to revive.
mission.properties|o.another_trace: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
help.properties|m.monster_gremlin: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against ELEMENTAL
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_elem: Greetings {0}, I'm Archilus, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high elemental damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the elemental attacks of constructs and gremlins. \n\nElemental resistant armor and shields are adapted from Owlite technology.  Though the Owlites themselves no longer exist, their amazing elemental mastery lives on in this gear.
item.properties|f.fireworks: During times of celebration, the Spiral Order devotes some of its munitions experts to create spectacular fireworks.
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm: In order to reach Spiral HQ's base of operations in Haven you will need to descend into the Clockworks and cross a massive chasm.  The journey will be a dangerous one and it is recommended that you have everything you need before departing. \n\nCompleting this mission will leave the Rescue Camp behind you.
item.properties|f.wild_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
mission.properties|b.whipping_mishandlin: After Recon Knights discovered a fiendish city known as Sol' Fork, Spiral HQ deployed a research team to station itself in the heart of the city and study the devilites within.  Their findings have become the basis for our understanding of devilite culture and their motives for working with gremlins. \n\nThis research team is in desperate need of supplies in order to maintain working on-site.  It would be of great help to Spiral HQ's continued research to have a squad enter the city and deliver the necessary supplies.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_4: I'm saying that we know this entire world isn't natural, and I for one don't believe that those hordes of miserable gremlins, no matter how industrious, could have built an entire world.  They had to have been aided by something far beyond their measure and perhaps whatever that is lies within the Core. \n\nThe same goes for the Alpha Squad.  They wouldn't just disappear, even within the furthest depths of the Clockworks.  They were our very best.  It was this Core that swallowed them.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the radiant seraphynx, battle sprite of those who wish to protect their party and provide them aid? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
item.properties|f.padded_armor: A loose-fitting set of light armor that is typically worn by gunslingers.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_3a: We thought things were getting pretty predictable, even at the depths you've been exploring.  The Core was in sight.  But now some kind of massive negative energy anomaly has surfaced above the Core, blocking access to it.  Recon Knights have said that all they see near it is fire, endless fire. \n\nWe don't know what it is just yet, but squads near that depth have already gone missing.  This is bad news.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_2: Victory is yours\! But will these warriors leave this hallowed hall of glorious combat and be forgotten, or continue on against even more terrifying foes in hopes of reaping the rewards of the Arena King?
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: I don't know if I feel better or worse after finding out what happened to everyone in the Core. Poor Grantz...Parma...Euclid...Rulen...
helptips.properties|m.atg_shield: Surrounded? Use your SHIELD to push back attacking enemies.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: I will provide you with a summary of each battle sprite. In recognition of your valor in rescuing these sprites, Spiral HQ has authorized you to bond with one. This bond will last forever and is a significant responsibility. \n\nPlease think carefully before making your decision; there is no going back once you decide.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_mail: Mythical armor crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_2a:
I've established a comlink with Knights that have formed a Rescue Camp up ahead.  If you head north, you should eventually reach it. 

I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp before sunset. 

And should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 5 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: A sprite's appetite will increase naturally over time, though slowly. To increase appetite quickly, take it for a run in the Clockworks. Absorbing heat from monsters is a great way to burn calories\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: You should get inside the town walls.  It's not safe out here.
conversation.properties|m.rc_soil_1a: I'm collecting geological samples for Spiral HQ. So far my tests are identifying hundreds of unique soil samples within every inch of the ground below our feet. This can't be possible, I must have miscalculated...
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_1a: How about this place, huh? Looks like some kind of old rail station overrun with restless spirits. What an odd place to find underground. \n\nAnyway, we better head to the cache of sprites fast given what we found back in the Sunset Steppes. Let's go\!
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Trojan \nThese massive leviathans are invulnerable from the front. Hit the crystal on their back to bring them to their knees.
item.properties|f.spiral_flak_jacket: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.powderkeg: Careful, this thing could go off like a metaphorical powder keg.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against shock, at the expense of fire and freeze resistance.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_b: Not much equipment has been salvaged from the crash pods.  There's not even enough here for each able-bodied Knight.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Required items will appear once your sprite is ready to level up. After your sprite has consumed enough heat, a 'required material' notice will appear above the feeding tray. This material MUST be fed to the sprite in order for it to advance further.
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_armor: A cerulean suit of armor for those who want to wreck some robos.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A simple display commemorating a knight's recruitment into the Spiral Order.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We saw the Gremlins hiding mines out there, watch your step\!
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of extremely low temperature material at an increased rate.
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige_lock: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Prestige Missions\!
item.properties|f.plasma_cell: A high-tech plasma source that could positively blind someone with science.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_4: A ceremonial sword issued to Vanguards of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
guild.properties|m.invite_message_name: Enter an optional message to {0} with your invitation\:
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Greetings {0}, and congratulations on becoming a Squire\!  Your performance has caught the attention of Spiral HQ and they have given you authorization to now take on Prestige Missions. \n\nPrestige Missions are select missions offered to you daily that offer prestige as rewards for completion.  Sometimes these missions require supplying Spiral HQ or other Knights with items and other times they will have you exploring the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: You can only carry one mineral at a time so choose the biggest one.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter: Subscribe now and get a free Proto Crest accessory\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_11a: Oh my\!  What is the connection between these gremlins and that Artifact anyway?
helptips.properties|m.p_dz_schematic_hei: Unauthorized access of our schematics library detected. Security team dispatched. Lockdown commenced.
item.properties|f.hexoskeleton: Protects the thorax, abdomen, and legs. No molting necessary.
conversation.properties|m.casino_jelly_c: One day I'll win enough to build my own palace\! Glorp glorp\!
item.properties|f.chroma_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a chromalisk, offering the wearer its distinguished look.
chat.properties|m.usage_summon: Usage\: /{0} player name\nSummons a player to your current location.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_6a: This is astounding\! The battle sprites you recovered from the Sunset Steppes have somehow morphed into a new entity\!
item.properties|f.buccaneer_bicorne: A trusty cap that offers tough protection from sun, wind, storms and spiteful seagulls.
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_2: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Restless Railroad where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites. Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles. You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
item.properties|f.culet: An elegantly designed suit of armor capable of flattering any form.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok: You are eligible for this mission.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_10: Congratulations {0}.  The Geo Knights owe a great deal to your efforts.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_3a: It's because the Strangers took us in that they're now targeted...
item.properties|f.crimsonite_shard: A shard of Crimsonite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_blade: A mythical blade that lashes out with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. Those who wield it claim to feel the fiery stare of the beast upon them whenever they close their eyes.
item.properties|d.recover_accessory: Recovers an accessory from an item, returning the accessory to your arsenal.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_wasd_mo: Mouse used for targeting, attacking and menu navigation
social.properties|m.levels_completed: become the new Level Leader, having completed {0} levels in the past 7 days\!
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_w: Glorp\! Glorp\! Winterfest is saved and one thing is clear\: all hearts now sing with holiday cheer\!
item.properties|f.swiftstrike_buckler: A small, easy to use shield that enables the user to perform fast attacks.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_3a: Should you attempt to enter the citadel and manage to reach the throne room, please, end his suffering.  Allow the souls he keeps bound to this world a chance to return to their loved ones. \n\nAnd one more thing- I've heard that some kind of force of nature had once tried to right his wrongs but Lord Vanaduke imprisoned it somewhere within his fortress.  Finding and freeing it may prove useful.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_bl: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
uplink.properties|e.already_received: That knight cannot receive another gift of this type.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit, another quill is fired from the target to the next available target.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_2: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 3 Star gear and receive certification
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: That and a solid arsenal, yeah.
helptips.properties|m.token_trader_info: Spiral HQ offers special items to select knights through the exchange of special tokens found within the Clockworks. These tokens are often earned from defeating fierce boss monsters and are proof of the owner's bravery.
item.properties|f.skolver_coat: The ultimate in Wolver-hide clothing, this coat has been expertly crafted to give your melee attacks extra power.
item.properties|f.round_helm: A svelte helm that's just waiting to be accessorized.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: Four Ways to Bring About the End of the World
item.properties|f.phial_phear: A glass tube containing a small dose of phearium, a strange chemical said to induce panic into anyone who even gets so much as a whiff of the stuff.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_2: Again, this is really weird Biscotti, but I'll do my best.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_1a: Hello there, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you will be needing a quick lesson in the species of monsters within the Clockworks that inflict piercing damage, yes?
shop.properties|m.accessoryDepotAd: Want to recover your accessory? Buy a recover ticket\!
social.properties|m.play_pvp: Sign up for a game of {0} {1} in the Coliseum\!
item.properties|f.guild_bond: Deposit in your guild's treasury to redeem the crowns.
item.properties|f.gel_drop: A drop of goo collected from a jelly. It's still quivering.
item.properties|f.lump_coal: A Grinchlin gift for those who have been naughty or nice.  Grinchlins are equal opportunity party poopers.
projectx.properties|m.mission_rjp: Recover the recon module in the Royal Jelly Palace.
helptips.properties|m.tglobby_equip: Inside the Clockworks, use Arsenal Stations to change your equipment.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_4a: Thanks, {0}.  I thought we were done for back there. \n\nLet's get the artifact back to Spiral HQ before someone else tries to nab it.
item.properties|f.furni_chest_spiralfoot: A sealed locker filled with important Spiral Order equipment, like socks.
item.properties|f.simple_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. While unrefined, this orb can be used to craft more powerful items.
item.properties|f.torpor_tantrum: The ultimate sleep bomb. It's like a bedtime story, only more explodey.
pvp.properties|m.love_reupload: Uploading a new file for the selected level.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Hmm, certain combinations seem to attract different kinds of monsters.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni:
Astounding\!  I would have never expected a new recruit to crawl out of that fiery wreckage alive\!  You must really be something else... 

The name's Feron, Lieutenant of the Spiral Order.  We had believed this entire complex was derelict until the elevator leading to it suddenly surged to life.  Upon investigating the whole place soon went up in a blaze\! 

How did you end up here?
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Well, I won't dishonor them by giving up now. We've come so far after all. 'Time to be a hero again\!' Right, {0}?
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7b: (Your words do not seem to faze the fallen knight, whose mind seems to be lost somewhere in the glories of his past life.)
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: It's even more beautiful down here\!
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_2a: Missions range from dangerous combat engagements to talking to certain people, such as myself.  By completing missions, you'll earn progress towards new ranks, which will in turn give you access to increasingly powerful gear.  Greta informed me that you'll be tackling our power supply problem in the Ancient Generator?
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_easy: Normal difficulty features challenges suitable for any player.
item.properties|f.divine_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_7a: {0}, I thought you would be taller.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_pu: A short torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
support.properties|m.option_206_0: If there is no doubt this was personal information then please click here to file the complaint.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_shield: A huge reinforced shield perfect for brushing off blows and fending off foes.
item.properties|d.gsc_vip: C O M P L I M E N T A R Y\n\nBecause you are a key casino patron, we are pleased to offer you membership free of charge.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_suit: Highly protective gear for the cutting-edge demolition man. The internal cooling system makes you feel a little like you've been cryogenically frozen.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_4a: Take it easy {0}, not all gremlins are cut from the same cloth.  Some disagree with the ways of King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order.  In fact, somewhere down in the Clockworks I'm told there's an entire town full of gremlins who left the Great Colony.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_5a: Thanks Kora.  I'll do my best.
item.properties|f.furni_table_spiral1: A small table that aspires to one day be combined with other tables to become a big table.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_5a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Want to earn even more Krogmo Coins with every match?
board.properties|m.auto_create_party: Sorry, we could not find you an available party. Do you want to start your own party?
uplink.properties|m.generic_change: Something changed and we had to change things. Please accept this attachment as a replacement. Sorry for the inconvenience.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_2a: Great\!  Now a quick lesson on charge attacks. \n\nCharge attacks can be performed with any weapon by holding down the ATTACK button and waiting for the charge aura to reach maximum charge.  You can still move around while charging\!
item.properties|f.force_buckler: A Proto Shield modified to resist stunning impacts.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_final: Just one more room lies between you and the elevator out of here. Remember what you have learned so far and you'll do just fine... at least that's the theory. Try not to die, ok?
item.properties|f.static_capacitor: An explosive device of Gremlin origin designed to produce a deadly field of electricity.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_1a: Thought you could just walk away with the artifact did you?  Hand it over now or I'll light this fuse and turn you into a million, tiny, smoldering bits\!
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_ultimate: Usage\: /{0} skill ultimate\nUpdates a sprite skill's ultimate value.
support.properties|m.subheader_step205: You should not be sending a complaint against someone just because they sent a complaint against you.\n\nGame Masters will read through all complaints, and if you didn't break any rules in the complaint that was filed against you, then you don't need to worry.
item.properties|f.furni_chair_manor: An exquisite chair, cunningly crafted for cozy comfort.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Seekers, the skillful grenadiers of the Kat Tribe.
prologue.properties|m.preface3: What we discovered was beyond imagination. We discovered Cradle.
helptips.properties|m.tut_treasure: Treasure blocks are always a lucky find\! They contain coins and useful items.
mission.properties|b.alchemy_mastery: Bosco in the Haven Bazaar has more information for you regarding the highest level of alchemy available to you.  Mastery level alchemy will be instrumental in your survival as you attempt to reach the Core of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.rescue_knight_: I've really been needing to stretch my legs.
item.properties|f.furni_chess: A statuesque figurine, ideal for use in a board game.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Moorcroft Manor.
item.properties|f.cold_iron_vanquisher: A powerful cold iron blade forged for the singular purpose of hunting down and destroying the undead.
item.properties|f.slumber_smogger_mkii: A Slumber Smogger modified to disperse sleepy smog over a wider range.
guild.properties|i.console_edit: Work with others to decorate and modify the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.snarble_barb: A bestial blade that can shoot slithy spines at those who would oppose its wielder.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_cap: A warm hat made from hide tanned with blaze pepper. It smells faintly of curry.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_1a: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.
mission.properties|m.status_deployed: Deployed\nKnights joining a deployed party will not receive completion credit for the mission.
mission.properties|b.return_of_ur: A Recon squad has reported that deep within a fiendish city, devilites are attempting to summon a legion of powerful trojan warriors.  Based on intel from a devilite internal memo, the trojans are known as the 'Legion of Ur,' and are said to have once numbered in the thousands.  Strangely, the memo indicated that the Legion of Ur was sealed away in the Underworld and that an alternative approach would be required for bringing them back. \n\nWhatever means the devilites intend to use to bring a few thousand trojans into the Clockworks, they must be stopped.  Infiltrate their city and stop the fiendish army before they become unstoppable\!
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_pur: A tall torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
guild.properties|m.confirm_deposit_treas: Are you sure you want to deposit into the guild's treasury? This can never be undone, not even by a GM.
item.properties|f.dim_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within flickers like a tiny candle.
sprites.properties|d.enduring_light: Increases the duration of the ray of light.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_1a: Hello again, {0}.  I understand you're well on your way to reaching the Core and need an arsenal that will keep you alive.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_crystal: Crystal blocks are like breakable blocks except that if destroyed, they also destroy the crystal blocks of the same color connected to them.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_64d528: Deposit a single mineral into a gate.
uplink.properties|m.confirm_att_account: This is an account-wide mail, you can read it with any of your knights but the attachment can only be accepted once.\n\nAccept the attachment now?
chat.properties|m.usage_invite: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nInvites a player into your current party.
guild.properties|log.crowns_added: Added {0} crowns to the guild treasury.
item.properties|f.swimsuit_trunks: A pair of spiral issue trunks intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_5a: Once freed you will collect an Apocrean Sigil as proof of your deed. Bring these to me and my friend here will reward you with special treasures I have collected during my time in this world. You can use these items to craft rare and powerful items using that obelisk of creation over there.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: What little we've recovered from the Core Terminal has every Geo Knight, Biotech, and Tech Knight absolutely stumped. We'll be analyzing these findings for quite some time.
pvp.properties|m.love_delete_confirm: Are you sure? The level will be deleted.
item.properties|f.prize_box_forge: Contains valuable rarities and other assorted items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_5b: And don't worry about applying skill points the 'wrong way,' since you will eventually gain enough skill points to max out all your skills\!
item.properties|f.pile_o_pillows: A freshly laundered basket of pillows, ready for throwing at your friends\!
mission.properties|b.vicious_viscous: Spiral HQ would like you to investigate levels of the Clockworks where the most powerful slime and beast monsters reside.  By exploring these levels and transferring your combat data back to Spiral HQ, all knights would ultimately benefit from your dangerous experience. \n\nIt is highly recommended that you equip yourself with piercing resistant gear with piercing and shadow damage weapons\!
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_shad: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
sprites.properties|d.drakon: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_suit: Reinforced armor intended for explosive experts.
item.properties|f.blast_bomb: An all-purpose bomb issued to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_4a: Heh, don't look now, {0}, but there's a ghost over your shoulder\! Let's hope these sprites haven't invested all their power into good looks. \n\nUse that one to clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
item.properties|f.dark_ember: A mote of burning energy salvaged from Lord Vanaduke's throne room. It slowly smolders with a sinister intensity, creating an almost hypnotic trance when gazed upon for any length of time.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll find those black kats and recover the Ancient Pages\!
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_3a: I'll be sure to get my hands on the appropriate gear for the job.
item.properties|f.overcharged_mixmaster: An industrial strength handheld mixer that is sure to stir things up.
item.properties|f.snarbostuffing: A dense, fluffy stuffing made from a special polymer that doesn't break down when exposed to the cursed fur of the Snarbolax. It's perfect for creating trophies or adorable, cursed, stuffed toys.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_crowns: Crowns are the currency of the Clockworks. You can use them to purchase all kinds of things like new weapons and armor. While playing with others, every party member gets crowns whenever anyone picks some up.
item.properties|f.iron_gear: A metal gear that was once a component of a complicated contraption.
mission.properties|o.true_champion: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.firefighter_helmet: Normally worn by firefighters, this helmet doesn't offer much defense but grants the wearer high fire resistance.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_4a: I take it the only way to the Core is through the Firestorm Citadel?
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_3a: I sometimes find dark matter mineral deposits in the Clockworks, perhaps-
shop.properties|m.cart_vitapod_adjusted: You may only equip one best vitapod\: cart adjusted.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_d: This is my first expedition into the Clockworks\!
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in_footer: By proceeding, you acknowledge and accept the terms and conditions linked below.
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_mask: A Salamander Mask imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_1: Well met, {0}\! Glad to see Spiral HQ sent us some reinforcements, and not a moment too soon\! Our backs are against the wall and we need your help\!
pvp.properties|m.bribe_reward_subject: King Krogmo reward earned in the Coliseum.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
The Clockworks have been so consistent for so long\! Just ticking along like, well... you know. But now *something is happening* and I don't know what it is\!\! 

I'm so excited\! 

Bring us samples of these Mysterious Spikes and we'll make good trades for them\!

They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.

mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_1a:

In any case, that's not relevant to today's data that I'm presenting.

mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.
helptips.properties|m.branch_path_warnin: You are safe, for now. Two paths lie before you. Listen to the recon modules here and choose your path.
mission.properties|o.sovereign_slime: Infiltrate the Royal Jelly Palace and find the mysterious energy source
item.properties|f.trojan_armor: The armor of the stalwart Spiral Wardens is said to give great comfort to other knights. Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_3: Magic?  What?  No, I'm talking about a psychic energy manipulation here, try and stay with me.  In any case,  elemental damage is produced by construct and gremlin family monsters.  Additionally, construct monsters tend to be weak to elemental damage themselves and gremlins to shadow damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?

conversation.properties|m.hunter_1a:
Hello there my good Knight, I am Armero, great hunter of the wilds and curator of this prestigious lodge you see before you. 

On the walls are some of the many trophies claimed from many courageous expeditions, where life and limb were put on the line in order to experience the pure, untamed thrill of the hunt. 

Now I say, do you have the same spark within you? The same taste for the open air, for danger?

item.properties|f.gold_wolf_hood: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Gold Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_4: Once you reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
item.properties|f.super_crystal_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more alloy. Apply directly to your foe's head.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
item.properties|f.token_page: A crumbling page torn from a long-forgotten grimoire of the Moorcroft Manor archives. The indecipherable language written upon it glows faintly in the dark as if containing power in its very words.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.starlit_hunting_coat: An advanced, star-soaked hunting coat that will keep you awake even as it coddles you in downy comfort.
chat.properties|m.usage_cheer: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCheer for your fellow players\!
global.properties|m.peer_shutting_down: The requested peer is shutting down.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Who sent you infernal, iron assassins?  Was it Herex? It matters not. There are ways of finding out...
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the amount of energy you want to buy, in multiples of 100.
mission.properties|b.blades_fallen:
Not every knight who enters the Clockworks returns to feel the sun on their face once more.  Within the perilous depths of the Clockworks, those that brave its dangers always face the reality that every expedition may be their last.  Sometimes their bodies can be recovered and other times all that is left is remnants of their gear. 

Just outside of Haven, Spiral HQ has built a soldier's graveyard where fallen knights can lay to rest.  As a Spiral Knight, you must face the reality of death in order to understand its gravity. 

Deliver the remains of an unknown knight, a sword, to a memorial within the graveyard.  But stay alert- dark energies resonate from the graveyard, attracted to the countless souls it houses.
item.properties|f.big_beast_basher: It was suggested that this brutally sharp mining pick could probably be used to hunt both beasts AND minerals. The Clockworks were never the same.
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.n: NOTE\: a stack (of {0}) of {1} was removed from the cart.

design.properties|i.place_room: Install a room at this location.
conversation.properties|m.gh_bechamel_1: Greetings {0}, what can I help you with?
item.properties|f.vial_freeze: A glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
sprites.properties|d.flame_barrier: Surround yourself with a barrier of flames that enhances your defenses while burning nearby targets.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Guuurgle\! Such strength\! You shall be consumed and your power added to my own\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_fiend_: I've got a case of the Mondays.
item.properties|f.alchemy_room: A utilitarian room equipped with two Alchemy Machines and a General Goods Merchant.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: The guy in Devil-IT wanted to upgrade our office to all glyph-usage, but I like wasting paper when I can.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_shield: A large, bony bulwark bathed in blackish brume. It occasionally issues a quiet, forlorn whisper, usually about remembering to block.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_7a: Grantz was the real veteran of the bunch.  A seasoned Guardian, Grantz specialized in keeping his squad safe, namely by crushing anything that would mean to do them harm. \n\nGrantz took his Guardian's Oath very seriously, often putting himself directly in harm's way in order to protect another.  The guy was selfless.  I imagine that if disaster truly befell the Alpha Squad, Grantz didn't let it end without one hell of a fight.
mission.properties|o.creators_and_create: Learn about the most powerful construct and gremlin monsters
support.properties|m.subheader_step201: Spamming is when someone repeats text or sends long lines of random characters with the sole purpose of annoying others because it fills up the chat screen so they can't chat normally.\n\nIt's important that you only file a spam complaint when the spamming was so bad that you couldn't chat with others. For example a couple of lines of a few characters, while not necessary perhaps, is not bad enough to file a complaint for. Also if the repeated lines are far between (like 10 seconds between) then it also won't prevent people from chatting, even if it may be annoying that they're just writing nonsense.
item.properties|f.guild_members_200: Allows your guild to recruit up to 200 members\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They... They got everyone except me. I just hid in the corner.
item.properties|f.blizzbreaker_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at shrugging off the coldest of shoulders. It's not bad at resisting freeze attacks, either.
item.properties|f.almire_bench: A balanced bench built for Almirian officials.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies protection and restoration. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat\: ray of light creates a steady beam of holy light, heart attack increases the chance of hearts dropping from monsters, and angelic aura creates a light shield that protects its knight and party members within. \n\nThe seraphynx is best suited for knights who wish to protect their party and provide them aid.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.spiral_crescent_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_crown: A regal crown resembling that of the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
item.properties|m.item_locked: This item is bound to you.\n
help.properties|m.monster_construct: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to ELEMENTAL - Strong against PIERCING
mission.properties|b.p_r4_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.

uplink.properties|m.mission_rewards: Attention {0}\!  Our data shows that a recent mission you successfully completed, {1}, did not issue rewards to you following the end of the mission.  These rewards are enclosed in this mail. \n\nPlease accept these rewards, gear up and continue your adventure\!
item.properties|f.hazardous_hedge_coat: A battle-ravaged coat worn by the squad leaders of the Scarlet Scouts, nicknamed 'hedges.' The name was likely coined due to their incredible flanking abilities or perhaps it is a reference to the spikes that adorn their armor.
item.properties|f.prize_box_ancient: Contains various unique items fashioned in the ancient, veiled homeland of the tortodrones. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.raging_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and razed the gates of a heavenly kingdom.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r9: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
dungeon.properties|m.firestorm_citadel_d: All that remains of the once great kingdom of Almire, the Firestorm Citadel houses the legions of lost souls burning in the flames of a forgotten war, endlessly rekindled by the twisted spirit of their former lord.
helptips.properties|m.tg_heat: Collecting Heat Embers will level up your gear when you reach an elevator.
uplink.properties|m.login_event: Hail, {0}\! Thanks for playing Spiral Knights\! As part of a special event, please accept the attached rewards to aid you in your adventures\! \n\nAnd don't forget to check out the Supply Depot for more rare items and special offers\!

mission.properties|m.new_threat_5a: {0}, something big is going down at the Lab.  You need to get here immediately\!
item.properties|f.kat_suit: A clawed costume made by Moorcroft tailors. It's perfect for curious knights who are prone to pause for naps after a long night of adventuring.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_12: Vanguard, eh?  The Rangers are always looking for skilled knights like you, {0}.  After all this pomp is done, come see me if you want to laugh in the face of death and danger once more\!
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_desc: A level where travelers can safely return to town, or journey further into the depths of the Clockworks.

mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_2a: What do you mean? Who are the Apocrea?
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_2a: Yes, Project R appears to be in fact two massive weapons known as the 'Roarmulus Twins.'  Designed by one of the Crimson Order itself, the Roarmulus Twins are some kind of construct cannon that the gremlins intend on moving up the Clockworks into the Haven Arcade\! \n\nBased on what the schematics suggest, their power far exceeds standard gremlin weaponry and could be truly devastating to Haven, Spiral HQ and the Strangers should it reach the Arcade.
sprites.properties|d.extra_hearty: Increases the chance of hearts dropping and duration of the enchantment.
mission.properties|b.breaking_in_recruit: After braving the depths of Firestorm Citadel, Spiral HQ believes you have earned a much deserved break. As a newly anointed Vanguard of the Spiral Knights, Lieutenant Feron believes you are the perfect candidate for training a group of raw recruits how to survive the dangers of this world. Your mission is to link up with the recruits on the surface of Cradle and help them survive their first tour of duty.
item.properties|f.flaming_pulsar: A pulsar modified with a scorching energy that burns greater over time. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_3b: Thanks for the information, I'll be off now.
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: We formed a barricade around the Artifact but it was overrun. I'm sorry...
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Undercorp employees get a free mug with every visit.
dungeon.properties|m.starlight_cradle_de: Beneath a moonlit sky azure islands drift in a sea of stars. These islands are home to creatures that are more than happy to creep upon those that succumb to this world's endless lullaby.

It was those blasted cloaking fiends\! They came from the shadows and staged an ambush.   When I get my hands on Seerus I'll... Argh\!

Blast, I'm having trouble gripping my sword...

mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r3: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4b:
Lastly please instruct your division to cease using our mail system to inform other Undercorp divisions that 'The freezing corruption of lord Maulos is inescapable.'  Improper use of the mail system hurts productivity. 

As your division's disciplinary action will undoubtedly result in relocation to the Eternal Torment Division, this will likely be our final correspondence.  I wish you luck in your continued career here at Undercorp. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp 

Attached\: Amu-Sol.pip

item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A fine display commemorating a knight's full acceptance into the Spiral Order.

pvp.properties|m.unsigned: You can sign up to play.

mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_5: It is time you entered the Hall of Heroes once more.  Having been fully Star Certified and successfully completed so many missions that have ensured the survival of the Spiral Knights on Cradle, Spiral HQ is preparing you for the high rank of Vanguard.
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: This thing is useless without power.  How are we supposed to defend ourselves from those monsters?\!
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r7: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Not all, but most of them are believed to have been directly manufactured from gremlin design, yes.  We think that most were originally engineered during the building of the Clockworks.  Some remain under gremlin control, others have gone rogue and the rest have become something else entirely.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_2a: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings. \n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
mission.properties|b.pierce_of_cake: Now that you are undertaking missions in 'Tier 2' of the Clockworks, monsters will begin inflicting special damage types that you need to be aware of and prepare for or else you could face certain doom\! \n\nOne of our lead Biotechs, Hahn, has prepared a brief lesson on piercing monsters.  Speak with him via comlink before taking on any further missions.
item.properties|f.lockdown_guardian_shie: A shield carried by a Spiral Guardian, a stalwart protector on the battlefield.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Firepower will only get you so far, {0}.  Case in point, the gremlins are no doubt strong on their own, what with just sheer numbers and all, but these little, furry geniuses sought to also bolster their strength by creating an army of constructs.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_12: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
item.properties|f.valestone_shard: A shard of Valestone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.phantamos: A powerful handgun brimming with dark energy. The Phantamos represents one of the most recent additions to the Spiral Knight's arsenal, as containing shadow energy of this degree took a great deal of research.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_mail: A viciously viscous set of armor crafted painstakingly from the most noble specimens of quivering slime.
item.properties|d.energy_well: USE\: An energy bank for use by guild members.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: There isn't much time. I can't reach you from here and you need to make it out. Warn headquarters. Warn Haven\! If the Core isn't kept sealed The Swarm will escape and it will continue to consume everything and everyone.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight4_1a: Recon teams have recovered some strange and remarkable things from within the Clockworks.
mission.properties|o.time_enough_at_last: Discover the fate of the lost knight within the Scarlet Fortress
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_9a: Yes I know. Anyway I also understand that some of the sprite transport crates were empty again. Something is not right... \n\nNow then, secure that last cache of sprites before whatever is stealing sprites finds it\!
item.properties|m.use_change_eye: Use your {0} to change your eyes?
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_d: With the power restored, I was able to mend my armor. Let's hope I don't run into too many of those monstrous rust buckets again\!
dungeon.properties|m.leaveparty_return: Leave the party and return to {0}.
item.properties|f.fine_fabric: A well-made length of sturdy cloth, swiped from a Clockworks inhabitant.
help.properties|m.monster_beast: Deal PIERCING - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against ELEMENTAL
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_suit: A Salamander Suit imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: According to these scans there should be some kind of power source in the depths below the camp, but it's being diverted somehow...
item.properties|f.gm_armor: Impressive indigo armor that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_shadow: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Shadow Key \n\nWARNING\: If this elevator is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the Shadow Lair. Choose your party members wisely\!
item.properties|f.lite_infantry: Tread lightly or lavish in the limelight, those that follow will benefit from hindsight.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_3a: When our technicians finally got the Skylark's communications systems online, we could not establish a link with the Alpha Squad and they have never been heard from since. Their channel is completely dead. \n\nTheir dead line is what has us all scratching our heads.  Our comlinks are built to withstand all manners of extreme conditions, even explosions.  Heck, they survived the Skylark going down after all.  There's nothing I can think of that could kill the link completely.
item.properties|f.blackhawk: A shadow-aligned handgun of incredible power, it's said to contain the soul of a knight who was only two days from retirement.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_elem: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
item.properties|f.prize_box_chess: Contains one randomly-chosen Chess Mini liftable statue furniture.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Come get warm by the fire.
item.properties|f.metal_sonic_mask: A sinister looking mask crafted by a mechanical genius whose ability is said to rival that of even the greatest gremlin Gear Sages.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_5a: We all sensed the moment you defeated Vanaduke. The entire citadel shook as he fell and for a moment we thought that this realm would be destroyed along with its ruler. You must be careful wandering these halls with the place coming apart like this\!
item.properties|f.gremlonium: A highly advanced compound created by gremlin engineers to power their most devious machines.  It constantly emits an unsettling hissing sound.
mission.properties|b.beyond_axes_of_evil: Despite your previous efforts, gremlins have reformed their logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley in order to supply their munitions plants with resources. Given the results of their last project, the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to end their eco-destruction before it becomes anything more serious\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_3: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r4: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.flare_popper: While never intended to be used in a party, Recon Rangers like to shoot signal flares into the air to celebrate missions where everyone comes back alive. Sadly, any Ranger will tell you that far too few of them are ever sent burning into the sky.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.bucket_of_bloons: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of water bloons. They look ready to pop so throw them at your friends\!
item.properties|f.fiery_vaporizer_mkii: A Fiery Vaporizer modified to disperse combustible material over a wider range.
item.properties|f.barrier_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The elemental resiliency of a tortodrone on the Long Migration should aid you on your own journies through harsh environments.
item.properties|f.capsule_health_ultra: A capsule that restores an extreme amount of health. Never leave home without one\!
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_7b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_3: they are waiting to ambush you ahead
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of fiend and undead family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'best free lecture yet' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_c2f28b: Complete a Tier 1 expedition without having to revive.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_2: Such bravery, such pluck\! Yes, perhaps with some luck you stand a chance against the terrible fiends that mean to destroy Winterfest dreams. \n\nSo note the addition of a Winterfest mission, take up your sword and I will grant you rewards\!
item.properties|f.storm_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used lightning to carve whole worlds from stone.
helptips.properties|m.loading18: Check out wiki.spiralknights.com, where brave adventurers document what they discover in the depths of the Clockworks\!
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_gunn: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 3 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_1a: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation. \n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
monster.properties|m.fired_3: Ahh, I'm gonna have to fire you. OK?
item.properties|f.clockblocker: A mechanical shield with machined wheels, pinions, and gears that mesh with exacting tolerances, making it a precision timekeeping instrument.
item.properties|f.silvermail: Strong, yet light armor for knights who've sworn an oath to hunt down and destroy the undead, wherever it may lurk.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_10a: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r7: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Feeding your battle sprite is easy\! Simply open up your battle sprite interface and select your sprite icon. From there you can select a material from your arsenal to drop into the feeding tray. \n\nOnce you've queued up a material for your sprite to synthesize, simply click 'feed to sprite' and bon appetite\!
item.properties|f.icebreaker_shield: A Frostbreaker Shield modified for increased protection against freeze.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
item.properties|f.sacred_shade_armor: A shadowy suit of armor built to outlast whatever might slink from the shadows.
item.properties|m.add_more_success: Add more fire crystals to increase chance of forge success and bonuses\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_f: I keep a sword around for close encounters.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2b: All traces of Compound 42 should be eliminated, along with the facility and any engineers not part of the inner fold. Remind the scorchers who find these orders uncomfortable that those who disobey shall soon hear my whisper in their ears. \n\nSeal the doors and burn everything to the ground.
uplink.properties|i.crowns: The number of crowns to attach.
item.properties|f.exp_west_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.blaze_pepper: A delectable spice prized by Clockwork denizens of all sorts. In powdered form, it has a terrible habit of clinging to absolutely everything.
help.properties|m.tier_3_monster: Monsters can utilize attacks that deal pure special damage (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW). Equip yourself appropriately\!
item.properties|f.storm_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and stormed the gates of a heavenly kingdom. Some say that thunderclaps are the eternal echoes of her siege.
item.properties|f.padded_hunting_coat: An upgraded coat for hunters that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_1a: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.crimsonite: A fabled mineral of a fiery, red color said to contain the passion, anger and strength of the life surrounding it.
item.properties|f.sunset_stetson: A sturdy hat for gunslingers that shouldn't cost you much more than a fistful of crowns.
item.properties|f.deadly_shard_bomb: A large chunk of Crimsonite primed with a potent explosive. No more depleted Crimsonite here\: this bomb's made with the good stuff\! Or the bad stuff, if you happen to be the target.
design.properties|e.furni_max_deployed: There are no available units of that furnishing to deploy.
steam.properties|e.already_converted: You have already converted one account to your Steam account. You cannot convert another.
item.properties|f.member_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Member rank and up.
projectx.properties|m.downloading: Please wait while we install the rest of the game.
item.properties|f.iron_buckler: A beaten little buckler made of iron that can withstand a bit more abuse than a Proto Shield.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_3a: I won't be able to relax until we've linked up with Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: Careful in there.  Looks like they had a big one with them...
mission.properties|m.new_threat_6a: There were sounds of shouting and explosions coming from the lab just now.  I think we may be under attack\!  Better gear up.  I've no idea what is going on in there but we'd better be prepared for anything\!
item.properties|f.book_of_dark_rituals: An ancient grimoire filled with unspeakable eldritch rites. Just like any cursed tome, there is likely some twisted individual out there who wants it for extremely nefarious purposes. Trade with caution.
steam.properties|m.confirm_convert: Are you sure?  The conversion cannot be undone.  Once complete, \nyou will be logged back in with your Steam account.
item.properties|f.serene_armor: An ancient suit of armor weathered by the elements. While standing in this armor you can sense the far-off tremors caused by the migration of countless tortodrones journeying to lands unknown.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_1a: I have lingered in halls even after all these long centuries, denied my eternal rest by my cursed lord. I feel his spirit clinging onto this shattered realm even now. He refuses to leave and thus dooms us all.
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm_b: Having restored power to the Rescue Camp and established contact with Spiral HQ, it's time you attempted to cross the chasm north of the Rescue Camp and reach Haven where the rest of the Spiral Knights have taken refuge. \n\nIn order to cross the chasm you will need to take an elevator down into the Clockworks and find another to bring you up on the other side.  There's no telling what dangers lurk in the dark depths below so Rhendon will be accompanying you on your journey.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_3: When you acquire a recipe and use it, it consumes the recipe, but logs it in your 'known' recipes forever\!  Once it's known, you can create as many items of that recipe as you wish, so long as you have the right materials.
item.properties|f.mighty_cobalt_helm: An advanced Spiral Knight helm forged from a rare alloy of Moonstone and Luminite.
item.properties|f.ultra_poison_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
projectx.properties|i.compatibility_mode: May prevent graphical glitches and boost performance for some\nsystems, but reduces graphical quality.
item.properties|f.ignition_helm: A lightweight helmet augmented to keep a knight's head cool under pressure.
social.properties|m.join_guild: Join your guildmate {0} at depth {1} in the {2} Gate\!
guild.properties|log.expansion_added: Added the {0} expansion for {1} crowns, plus {2} crowns for pro-rated upkeep.
item.properties|f.brimstone: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
sprites.properties|d.maskeraith: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
item.properties|f.celestial_ore: An extremely rare metal of great power said to be from the heavens above.  It is often completely wasted on crowns and jewelry for slime royalty.
item.properties|f.warp_dust: A light dust left behind when a creature travels at unbelievable speed. It tastes great in dip.
mission.properties|o.crimson_chaos: Investigate a Crimson Order base that has suddenly gone silent
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_mouse_move: Mouse used for targeting, attacking, movement and menu navigation
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of luminite.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
mission.properties|o.go_shopping: Visit the Haven Bazaar and discover what it has to offer
mission.properties|r.laboratory_visit_5a: Leave it to me, Morlin. I'll secure those sprites.
item.properties|f.armor_ankle: An accessory that can be attached to the ankle of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
dungeon.properties|m.ancient_generator_d: Beneath the Rescue Camp is a massive energy source, capable of powering the elevator to Haven if only it could be harnessed.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_2a: Well then you'll need one of these\!  It's a Proto Bomb and it's good for making things go boom\! \n\nI had an extra one in my pod so consider it an advance reward for saving all our hides here.
chat.properties|m.fail_format: {0} is appalled at that display of failure.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_8a: Yes.  It would seem as though we have much to learn of this place. \n\nRhendon's report noted that many of the sprites were missing from the site. He suggested foul play.
item.properties|f.guild_storage: Permanently adds Member Storage, Veteran Storage and Officer Storage options to Guild Command Console. Storages allow guild members of sufficient rank to exchange unbound items with other guild members.
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_ma: A Salamander Mask reinforced with volcanic iron. In the field it can be used as a makeshift coffee pot, so long as you don't mind coffee that tastes a little like lizard.
helptips.properties|m.zone: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to exit current zone.
item.properties|f.prize_box_electric: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in an Electric style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_8a: Yes, it seems that these sprites have mastered the ability to focus their powers on skills that protect their knight. Given that and their appearance I've dubbed them 'seraphynx.'
item.properties|f.maskeraith_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Maskeraith Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
chat.properties|m.usage_level_up: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [crystals]\nAttempts to level up the specified equipment using fire crystals.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A magnificent display commemorating a knight's ascension to the highest echelon of the Spiral Order.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Can't...go on...
item.properties|f.bottomless_stocking: An interdimensional tear in this fuzzy fabric sock swallows any item placed within it.  It even swallowed the stitches.
item.properties|f.wrench_wand: A heavy hand tool favored by Gremlins. It's good for both tightening bolts and cracking skulls.
item.properties|f.torchstone: A small rock that smolders constantly. Gremlins patrolling the Cooling Chambers occasionally use them as a hand warmer.
item.properties|f.wizard_box: Contains one of various unique weird and wonderful wizardly items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!

uplink.properties|m.bid_outbid: Visit the Auction House for another chance at this item\!

mission.properties|o.p_fast_advancement: Quickly power up your Knight's gear\!
item.properties|f.firetail_mail: A scorching simian mail typically worn by commanders in combat. It will ward off many wounds made to the wearer.
conversation.properties|m.deskclerk_1a: Welcome to Moorcroft Manor, where tired spirits come to rest their legs (if applicable). Enjoy your stay\!
mission.properties|o.advanced_alchemy: Visit Bosco and discover the potential of advanced alchemy
projectx.properties|m.cross_the_chasm: Cross the chasm to reach Haven.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Get inside, use the elevator...blow up whatever is controlling those cannons\!
conversation.properties|r.emberlight_vis: I have enough info, thanks. (End conversation)
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite: (The remaining pages are too deteriorated to decipher anything further save for a date of the events described which suggest that the Kingdom of Almire was destroyed over a thousand years ago.)
item.properties|f.heavy_splinter_bomb: A solid chunk of synthetic mineral with an explosive surprise inside. Wolvers hate surprises.
conversation.properties|m.rc_warning_1a: Up these stairs lies the gate to Haven. Be sure to talk to Virgil before you enter so you know what to expect.
conversation.properties|r.monsterboost_s: And... Anomalie is signing off on this?

conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We're cut off\!  Please help us defeat those lichens\!

helptips.properties|m.lock_howto:
* There are multiple Control Points scattered around the map 
* Capturing and holding a Control Point increases your team's score over time 
* To capture a Control Point, stand on it until it changes to your team's color 
* The team with the highest score at the end of the match WINS\!
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r9: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: At any given time a sprite has a 'favored item', a special material that it enjoys eating the most. Feeding one of these to your sprite is a great treat and grants the sprite a lot of heat.
admin.properties|d.load_tester: Spawns PseudoPlayer clients to test the server. Not recommended for use on production deployments\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_a: Last night terrible monsters attacked us in the darkness.  It was utter chaos. With no power for the turrets we couldn't defend ourselves. \n\nSo many brave Knights lost...
dungeon.properties|m.scarlet_fortress_de: Named for its vibrant tapestries, the Scarlet Fortress is a deconstructed mass of a forgotten castle, drifting endlessly in the void of the Clockworks. Strange bestial ghosts haunt its long corridors, tirelessly pursuing those that enter their domain.
item.properties|f.voltech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of electricity at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_shield: Prime protection for pretenders to the jelly throne.

mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_4: Great\!  I'll meet you near the exit once you've cleared them out.  Careful though, they seem to have adapted the use of birthday candles as weapons...
item.properties|f.eye_pack_suited: Contains a suite of suitable eye shapes for your style kit\: Club, Diamond, Heart, and Spade.
item.properties|f.fiendglyph: A fragment of a Fiendish ID Card. Combining five different glyphs into an ID Card will allow you to open the Grim Gate in the Ancient Grove.

item.properties|f.warm_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns strong enough that it feels warm to the touch.
sprites.properties|d.firestorm: Summon the power of true dragon fire to burn everything in your path.

projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in: Join the Coliseum Crucible to test community PvP levels\:
helptips.properties|m.tut_bash: When your shield is full, press [[SHIELD_BASH]] to bash and stun monsters\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We wouldn't have made it past that artillery without your help\!
item.properties|f.scythe: An old farmers tool, retired for the season, this blade also excels at reaping your foes.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: It looks artificial, but it seems to have a sinister awareness...
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_4a: Hey, it looks like one of the sprites has taken a liking to you\! Well, let's not let that extra power go to waste, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. You use your new friend to help clear the rest of the area of hostiles.
item.properties|f.pumpkin_bombhead_mask: A Bombhead Mask bearing a meancing grimace reminiscent of the great, gourdly Punkin King.

helptips.properties|m.atg_vitapods: Pick up VITAPODS to temporarily increase your maximum health until you return to Haven.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_5a: Then I now authorize you to take on Arcade Missions.  You can access the Arcade via your Mission interface or approach the gates directly here in the Arcade itself. There is a massive world beneath your feet waiting to be explored.\n\nGood luck to you\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4a:
Re\: Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

I've contacted Internal Affairs regarding the recent theft of an everfrost pillar and the 'disappearance' of nearly 1,000 devilite data entry associates, as I believe it to be directly related to your recently denied resource allocation request. 

Disciplinary action will be required.  Additionally, please fill out the attached Personal Improvement Plan and return it as soon as possible.

mission.properties|m.intro_arcade: Arcade Missions allow you to explore the ever-changing Clockworks without specific objectives. Visit the Haven Arcade to discover how you can transform the Clockworks to suit your needs\!
helptips.properties|m.tg_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those retrodes weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_8a: Perhaps gremlins are trying to steal our technology?
mission.properties|b.dreams_and_nightmar: Respond to the distress signal from the Core Terminal. We have no intel on what to expect. \nThis is a dangerous mission. Prepare for anything.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_helm: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.kilowatt_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to deliver an unpleasant shock on impact. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.wild_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.exp_center_4f: An expansion that adds a small central room to the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|o.eye_of_needle: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
helptips.properties|m.atg_treasure: GREEN Treasure boxes contain crowns and other useful items\! RED Treasure boxes are rarer than green blocks and contain better items\! HEART boxes contain hearts that will restore your health.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A scaled-down model of the Royal Jelly. He'd probably be flattered by it if he hadn't already been flattened.
dungeon.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to regain full health and perform an ENERGY BLAST\!
item.properties|f.stoic_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
uplink.properties|m.rank_mig: Spiral Knights has recently undergone a change that has added new mission rewards to missions you have already completed. They are attached.\n\nEnjoy\!
mission.properties|m.elig_ok_replay: You are eligible to replay this mission.
helptips.properties|m.loading10: If you become shocked you will regularly spasm from the electricity coursing through your body. This will interrupt anything you are doing.

sprites.properties|d.firebolt: Launches a searing ball of fire that explodes on impact.
