Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.

However, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\! 

This room offers a bonus chance at the treasures within.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_shield: This weathered wobbling wall can withstand a walloping when wielded by unwaveringly willed warriors.
helptips.properties|m.tut_explosive: Explosive blocks will harm anything around them when they are set off. This includes you\! Take them out from a safe distance with your handgun.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We don't know for sure but it has to be related to the Artifact. The energy signatures are identical. If the Artifact is involved that means...
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_1a: Well met, {0}, Champion of the Spiral Knights.  Your service to our cause has been of the highest caliber.  Without you, reaching the Core would still be a dream.  Now, we have a chance of actually restoring the Skylark and returning home.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: You have {0} friends playing Spiral Knights\!
item.properties|f.mad_bomber_mask: A sturdy helmet designed to keep out explosions, radio waves and high-tech mind control devices. At least, that's what they *want* you to think it does.
item.properties|f.gilded_griffin: A beautiful pistol named after a great, noble beast. Its golden frame was believed to provide light within the impenetrable darkness of the Underworld.
shop.properties|m.name: Name
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_2a: Wow, sounds like I have a lot to learn\!
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_shield: Up ahead is another great opportunity to use your shield. Remember, you can defend with your shield by pressing and holding the X key.
item.properties|f.power_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.armor_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
item.properties|f.heavy_hatchet: A big blade intended to fell trees. Unsurprisingly, you can also use it to fell enemies, blocks, mineral deposits and most anything else you'd care to hit with it.
item.properties|f.justifier_hat: A finely-made hat for handgun experts who think nothing of spending a few crowns more on a high-quality piece of gear.
helptips.properties|t.parma_recon_2: Recon Module\: Entrance to the Core
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of moonstone
conversation.properties|r.lab_biscotti_4: Where can I acquire these items?
item.properties|f.ecto_drop: A bit of ectoplasm meticulously collected from an unwilling undead volunteer. It's an unpleasant shade of green.
design.properties|i.place_door: Install a door at this location.
helptips.properties|m.loading2: Armor and helms not only offer physical defense, but can also protect you from status conditions. The right combination will greatly increase your chance of survival.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_coat: This well-made hide coat is self-heating, protecting the wearer from freeze attacks. The secret? A tiny pinch of blaze pepper.
guildhelp.properties|m.emporium_info:
The Birdsong Emporium allows high-ranking guild members to purchase items for the guild using funds from the Guild Treasury. These items include various Guild Hall furniture items and upgrades. Purchased items go directly into the Guild Treasury, and thus cannot ever be removed from the guild.
 Furniture comes in a variety of types and sizes and is used to decorate your Guild Hall's rooms and halls to make them feel more like home. Some furniture even has special effects when activated\! Any furniture currently in your Guild Treasury can be placed into the Guild Hall using Design Mode.
 The Birdsong Emporium is also where you purchase Guild Upgrades that enhance your guild's capabilities, such as by increasing its maximum member count.
 As a Guild Hall's size increases by adding expansions, the selection of items available in the Birdsong Emporium's catalog also increases. Be sure to check back often to see what's available\!
guildhelp.properties|l.design_console: Design Mode can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.swimsuit_wrap: A spiral issue sarong draped over a one piece suit intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: It'll take forever to decipher this gremlin cryptography...
item.properties|f.fiery_diskgun: A handgun powered by an infernal engine that launches molten disks in rapid succession. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_2: they will kill us they will kill you
conversation.properties|r.dark_harvest_e: Sounds like fun\!  I'm off to find the Punkin King\!
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_shock: We've been receiving reports that Groat, a local Emberlight chef has been acting... strange. It seems that Biscotti commissioned him to do some baking on her behalf but the responsibility may have gone to his head.  He disappeared into the Clockworks soon after Biscotti delivered the last crate of batter. With the Anniversary celebrations at stake once again, Biscotti needs some culinary champions to help her sort out this mix-up\!
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning: The server will be rebooted in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|f.illuminating_ward: A personal candle for warding off the darkness, and that which lurks within it.
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige: Prestige Missions are bonus missions offered to you daily. Completing Prestige Missions earns you prestige.
item.properties|m.unlock_slime_prompt: A Slime Key (or Silver Key) is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
item.properties|f.padded_demo_helm: An upgraded helm for bombers that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
mission.properties|r.honor_duty_1a: It's been an honor to serve, Lieutenant.
item.properties|f.supply_standard_compac: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This standard pack has enough supplies to last a few Knights one week.
item.properties|f.furni_block_ice: A block made of densely packed snow. It's perfect for assembling elaborate snow forts\!
item.properties|f.red_saber: A saber the color of the burning sun that is given to knights who have shown exemplary bravery in past actions.
chat.properties|m.ident_set: Your forum identity has been set to this knight.
projectx.properties|m.find_rhendon: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
chat.properties|m.usage_accessory: Usage\: /{0} (armor helmet) [clear | accessory name]\nAdds an accessory to the equipment or clears all accessories.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_4a: It's all a bit too convenient.  But do gremlins really have this kind of power?  I suspect something more than even what they are capable of engineering. \n\nIn any case, this Almire, it's not a kingdom any longer.  All that remains is a great citadel that seems to be engulfed in never-ending flames that Spiral HQ has been calling the 'Firestorm Citadel.'  From what we can tell, the whole place is swarming with undead and built like a fortress.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_3c: Remember, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
mission.properties|b.best_of_beast: After a recent promotion, Biotech Hahn has earned the title of 'Chief Biotech.' He was informed of your recent accomplishments and would like to give you a quick briefing on what you can expect from the beast and slime family of monsters as you approach the Core.
item.properties|f.shadow_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire shadow rounds.
exchange.properties|m.getenergy_tooltip_: Click here to complete your purchase.
helptips.properties|m.atg_togswitch: Switches can open AND close doors.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_ro: A festive new years snipe that will explore its surroundings.
mission.properties|b.delved_too_deep: The truth has been revealed. It's time to update Intel Agent Kora and Spiral HQ about what you and Lieutenant Vaelyn have learned.
item.properties|f.rugged_robo_wrecker: An upgraded robo wrecker that has assisted a great many constructs in becoming smoldering, scrap metal heaps.
item.properties|f.ultra_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I don't know about that... I'm fine here amongst all these ancient tomes.  I've got plenty to read, more than I ever could in a lifetime.  But I suppose that won't be a problem. \n\nPlease, just head on back to Haven.  Let my squad know that I'm ok and that I'm safe.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_4: I mean that the Core isn't a big battery that runs this world, but rather it and the whole of this world is a massive prison designed to keep something from ever leaving. \n\nThink about our geo-scans of Cradle just before the crash- they show it as being composed of hundreds of massive slabs of other worlds, almost like plates of armor.  Then you have the Clockworks, the most unnatural thing I've ever seen.  An entire world whose sole purpose seems to be stopping anyone from ever reaching its Core.
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_4a: I'll make it.  Just you wait.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.

item.properties|f.fire_raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings and a thick coat of ash.

sprites.properties|d.golden_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
mission.properties|m.new_threat_3a: Spiral HQ believes you are our best choice to help track down the energy signature, since you were the one to bring us the Artifact in the first place.  Rhendon will be dispatched to get on the trail of the gremlins below.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro2_1a: ...come in, {0}, are you there?  This is Recon Knight Rhendon\!
item.properties|f.furni_crate_toughbox_w: It's filled with dangerous explosives and razor-sharp swords\! Keep out of reach of children.

conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_7: Now that you know about the Forge, would you like to give it a look?
item.properties|f.vial_curse_super: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of crimsonite.
mission.properties|o.delved_too_deep: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_6b: I don't see or hear any of those things.
mission.properties|b.great_escape: Recon Knights have collected intel that has revealed the gremlin 'Crimson Order' has begun ordering gremlins to build makeshift prisons within the Clockworks where Spiral Knights are being taken and imprisoned.  It is believed that these orders are coming in direct response to your destruction of the Roarmulus Twins. \n\nFurther data suggests that these makeshift prisons are a temporary solution until a larger facility can be built.  Spiral HQ however, has no intention of these imprisoned knights staying long enough to find out.
guild.properties|m.published: The Guild Hall has been updated\!
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_2a: I was imprisoned here over a thousand years ago for speaking out against my liege lord, sentenced to be here for a lifetime as my punishment.  When the fires overtook the citadel even in my passing I did not find freedom.  My soul is bound to these cursed stones.
sprites.properties|d.bristle: Increases the number of quills fired and their sticking duration.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_5: Good luck to you. And try to stay warm\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Backup at last\! {0}, look\! The Core is opening\!
item.properties|f.valiance: This high-performance handgun is a symbol of the Spiral Order, and is proudly worn by veteran members. As it is often said, a knight need not have courage\: just Valiance.
projectx.properties|p.use_style_kit: Spend 1,000 crowns to modify your style?
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
item.properties|f.arthro_pod: A streamlined helmet fashioned after the tough chitin of a beetle's carapace.
item.properties|f.mad_bomber_suit: Some people have axes to grind. Others have points to make. This armor is for those of us with explosive tempers.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_6a: I'll contact you again soon, good luck {0}\!
conversation.properties|r.sl_guard_3: I'll get a Shadow Key and start investigating\!
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of construct and gremlin family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'other very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge for the second time' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
board.properties|i.formparty: Create a party that anyone can join.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_3: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
item.properties|f.lite_shield: A lightweight knight light that offers holistic protection.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_4a: We need you to explore the surrounding levels and collect any intel you can.  You can start with an Owlite castle of some sort that recently surfaced near this anomaly.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_4: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.pummel_gun: A Punch Gun properly modified for combat use. The recoil from its powerful charge attack is notorious amongst recruits.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
auction.properties|e.auction_bid: The auction may not be cancelled, it already has a bid.
item.properties|f.glowing_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns bright enough to light a darkened room.
item.properties|f.training_room: A simple room providing access to a private guild training hall, perfect for learning new skills or keeping old ones current.
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_1: I'd like to know how I can help.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Whatever that was, we're here now. Wherever here is. It looks like our only option is to see where this leads.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_1a: Thanks for your help earlier. Stay safe\!
item.properties|f.padded_hunting_cap: An upgraded helm for hunters that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
item.properties|f.silverweave: A length of understated cloth intricately interwoven with precious metal. It's tastefully ostentatious, yet prudently protective.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_rank: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\!
item.properties|f.maidens_tear: A sacred jewel cherished by Almirian knights.  Given to them by their beloved, it is said to keep them safe in battle.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_8a: Take it easy {0}, not all gremlins are cut from the same cloth.  Some disagree with the ways of King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order.  In fact, somewhere down in the Clockworks I'm told there's an entire town full of gremlins who left the Great Colony.
conversation.properties|m.rescued_strang: Hello little one.  You will find there are many dangers in this new world but also many opportunities for the adventurous and brave\!  A fellow of yours awaits you just up the path.  We will undoubtedly see each other again.  Farewell for now\!
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2c: All battle sprites wear a mechanical harness that aligns their skills to a damage type. Not all sprites can wear all harnesses though. For example, a drakon cannot output piercing damage. \n\nBy default, you have an iron harness that any sprite can equip. If you want to branch out as you likely do with your weapons and gear, you need to purchase new harnesses.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_234: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.raging_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe razed the world in its passing\: its rage became magma rain, its breath a typhoon.
craft.properties|m.transmute_max_in_flig: Waiting for previous transmutations to finish...
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_2a: You stand within the Hall of Heroes, where the best of the Spiral Knights offer what they can to aspiring knights.  Knights like you yourself once were when you first emerged from your drop pod and found your way to Haven. \n\nAnd after so many successful missions, daring rescues and exemplary performance in battle, you now stand fit to join these heroes.
mission.properties|o.king_of_ashes: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the Firestorm Citadel and reach the Core
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
item.properties|f.black_kat_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_7a: I'll take the artifact to the Lab.  When you're ready you should head into Haven and meet up with the rest of the crew.  I have a feeling we might be stuck on this planet for quite some time, so we might as well see what we can do to help.
sprites.properties|d.violent_heart_attac: Targets destroyed while enchanted create an explosion.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer_mkii: A Toxic Vaporizer modified to disperse noxious agents over a wider range.
help.properties|m.support_4: To report a bug in the game, press F2. Keep in mind that bug reports are not answered, but they include non-personal debug information that helps track down the root of the problem. If you need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
item.properties|f.electron_bomb: Adapted from several unconventional Gremlin theories on physics, anyone unlucky enough to be dragged into this bomb's blast is in for a shock.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: We almost didn't make it out alive. One moment everything was fine and the next thing we know gremlins are bursting out of the ground\!
item.properties|f.gh_env_snowing: A beautiful environment that fills your Guild Hall with perfect snow\: the kind that gently falls from the sky and never collects on the ground, melting into gray muck.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_4: In order to venture deep enough to reach the Core you must visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 5 Star Certification.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_helm: A hardened helm made to protect intrepid explorers while they explore the unknown.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_2: I am a sprite, a force of nature summoned to this realm to extinguish the unnatural fire that is consuming it. But Vanaduke discovered and imprisoned us. I managed to escape, but the other sprites remain in his custody.\n\nNow none may proceed beyond the court as columns of shadow fire block all exits. Shadow fire can only be extinguished with the water that flows from these spirit wells. The water is the purest found in all of nature, flowing directly from the springs within the realm of the Spirit Mother herself.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2b:
Transmission\: 

'They continue to advance and thwart our schemes\!  How could they have discovered Project R?  Why was there no advance warning of the attack?' 

'Herex and his minions were supposed to be spying on them but they have all vanished like cowards.' 

'To defy the Iron Law is to defy the Order\!  Track the traitor down.  Herex will answer for this setback.'
projectx.properties|e.name_too_long: Sorry, the name is too long.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies deception and debilitation. Its skills focus on subterfuge\: caustic quills fire poisonous quills that explode when followed with an attack, shadow cloak allows a knight to become invisible to monsters, and hexing haze allows the knight to inflict monsters with a timed damage blast. \n\nThe maskeraith is best suited for knights who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.slumber_smogger: An alchemical bomb that fogs an area with a sleep agent.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus: Glorp, glorp, glorp\!  Merry Winterfest\!\n\nGet into the holiday spirit with snowball fights in wintery Lockdown levels and turn in those Krogmo Coins for splendid Santy Hats\!
helptips.properties|m.tg_pots: Some objects can be picked up and used or even thrown across the room. Try throwing a pot at that switch.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_4a: Yes, I suppose we just might.  Safe travels then, {0}.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We'll hold the line\!
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_snipe: A quietly resting snipe that will stay where it's placed.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
item.properties|f.cuirass: A tight-fitting suit of armor that is all business and no pockets.
prologue.properties|m.preface2: We, the crew of the Skylark, fled to the stars seeking a source of incredible power, our last hope to save our homeworld.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100
item.properties|f.holiday_hat: A festive cap that carries with it the warm spirit of the holidays. It smells faintly of gingerbread.

conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: In most cases this is just a standard favored item, but when your sprite is ready to evolve, an Evo Catalyst will be required.

conversation.properties|m.vise_seerus:
Hello there lad\!  
Taking on ol' Seerus aye?  Careful now, he's not right in the head. Proper imbalanced that one.  

He and I go way back, but not in any way worth remembering.  Should your mission prove successful, see if you can bring me back a little souvenir.  I'll make ya something nice for your troubles.
item.properties|f.snow_hat: A comfy winter hat, keeping you warm whether hunting frozen jellies or merely melting marshmallows in your hot chocolate.
shop.properties|m.unbindeDepotAd: Out of energy? Get more in the supply depot\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_sig: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'

item.properties|f.toxic_needle: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts dosed with a wicked poison.

conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What have you learned about Almire?

mission.properties|b.minerals_rock: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is responsible for researching the strange minerals that Knights have begun mining from within the Clockworks.  He believes that they may hold the answer to gaining entry into the Core and retrieving the energy needed to restore the Skylark. \n\nMeet with him in the Haven Arcade and gain an understanding of how you can help his research as well as harness the true power of the Haven Arcade\!
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_1a: Thanks Kora.  I owe a lot to your intel.
helptips.properties|m.terminal_1: Welcome traveler, this is a Clockwork Terminal. Take a moment to rest and change your gear. \n\nUse the elevator either to return to Haven or delve into a more dangerous stratum of the Clockworks.
exchange.properties|i.mini_buy: Instantly buy energy with crowns at the energy exchange.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet3_1a: You've restored the power and saved us all, {0}\!  I can't thank you enough, all these recruits owe you their lives. \n\nYou should now try to contact Spiral HQ via your comlink.
item.properties|f.cold_iron_carver: An enchanted sword crafted from cold iron whose blade wards off the creatures of the dark.
helptips.properties|m.atg_healpad: Stand on a HEART GENERATOR to restore your health\!
guild.properties|m.formation:
You may form a new guild for {0} crowns and {1} energy. The crowns will be seeded into the guild's treasury. By creating a guild you will become the Guild Master and will have the ability to invite new members into your guild. Guild features include\:
Personal Guild Hall for Guild Members only
Guild Member chat channel
Guild Officer chat channel
Guild Member rankings
Guild Member status updates
mission.properties|m.pioneers_2a: It should, there're plenty of new recruits that chatter about them constantly. They're like heroes to some knights. \n\nThe Alpha Squad was an elite squad of knights that Ozlo personally selected to first enter the Clockworks in an effort to locate the source of the massive energy signal below.  Because all systems on the Skylark were offline for several weeks, radio communication was not possible.  Instead, they left a series of recon modules throughout their travels, sort of like a breadcrumb trail.
mission.properties|m.elig_not: You are not eligible for this mission.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a temperamental warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: We've recovered what little remains from Owlite Keep concerning the Kingdom of Almire. Combined with the snippets we've gotten from the nature sprites within Firestorm Citadel itself, we are starting to get a clearer picture of Almire's history.
mission.properties|m.steam_overlay_disab: The Steam overlay must be enabled in order to purchase expansions. Please ensure that "Enable Steam Community In-Game" is checked in the Steam "In-Game" settings, then restart the game.
item.properties|f.deadly_dark_matter_bom: A large chunk of Dark Matter primed with a potent explosive. This bomb would be in stark violation of the Spiral Order's safety handbook if they hadn't lost the last copy in the crash.

With the sun setting fast, it's up to you to enter the dark depths below the camp and locate an Ancient Generator. \n\nIf you can restore power to the camp, the Spiral Knights can power their turrets and create a defensive perimeter. Once secure, it may be possible to reconnect with Spiral HQ.

mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.heavenly_guardian_armo: Brilliant, white armor worn by those who defend the heavenly realms.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_3a: Indeed\! Monster trophies will require a great deal of materials, so it is only reasonable that a group effort is required. \n\nLastly, some of the materials you will need can only be acquired by spending boss tokens with Brinks in the Haven Bazaar. They act as proof of your valor in defeating such fearsome creatures\!

Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!

item.properties|f.infernal_guardian_armo: Charred, stygian armor worn by those who defend the infernal depths.
item.properties|f.hood: A mystical hood whose greatest power is concealing the wearer's identity.

item.properties|f.stranger_hat: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  It seems to have small, colorful feathers hiding in every seam.
mission.properties|b.oilers_in_boilers:
A boiler room beneath Moorcroft Manor has been overrun by a legion of oily slimes known as 'oilers' that seem to enjoy fiery conditions.  This could prove disastrous for any levels in close proximity should the slimes enter the boilers and cause an explosion. 

Moorcroft Manor serves as an invaluable connection point into Tier 2 and its departed residents have been the most gracious of hosts.  It is in Spiral HQ's best interest to send a squad in to deal with the smoldering slimes before they create a firestorm that seals off our access to Tier 2. 

It is up to you to locate the oilers and remove them from the boilers\!
mission.properties|b.honor_duty: Lieutenant Feron would like a brief word with you regarding your achievement in breaking through the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.charming_cap: The sort of hat one would wear for charming charming.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Don't forget to prime your bomb\!
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_3: Then use them with honor and let them protect you from the fury of the countless foes you will soon face.  The Core that we seek, there's something truly dreadful about it.  I know that it may very well be what gets us home, but I can't shake this feeling that we've been thinking about it all wrong.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_9a: Here we have... me\!  I'm the Accessorizor, adding accessories to your gear so long as you have a ticket.  With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
monster.properties|m.overtime_3: Glad I caught you. I'm looking for someone to really rise to the challenge this weekend...
social.properties|m.party_dissolved: Oops\! That party no longer exists.

mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_1a: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven.  To start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.

chat.properties|m.unknown_command: Unknown command {0}. Use /help to list commands.

item.properties|f.shadow_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful shadow bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.fang_of_vog: A sword said to be created from the fang of the fire beast, Vog.

item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A breezy blue plant inside a cheerful pot.
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_mail: A suit of Spiral Plate Mail with a supercharged internal power source. The upgrade didn't make the armor any lighter.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_2a: Smashing\! Then perhaps you and your mates will be of service to this lodge. You see, the alchemy machine you see before you can craft magnificent monster trophies for your Guild Hall. \n\nThe alchemy machines uses materials and crowns from your Guild Treasury and deposits the results into the Guild Treasury as well.

item.properties|f.zee_core: A pungent mass pulled from a slimy assailant. Its aroma is an excellent remedy for insomnia, as well as nighttime sniffling and sneezing.
projectx.properties|m.pvp_costume: Costumes blocked due to Coliseum game.

mission.properties|m.new_chapter_3a:
Spiral HQ has authorized you to visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification. 

The Hall of Heroes is a place where Knights rising in the ranks like yourself will visit to both learn about and acquire new recipes for gear as well as receive certification to go deeper into the Clockworks. 

Your first visit requires only that you wear all 2 Star gear, which you already have so it should be a piece of cake\!
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_3a: I'm all ears Kora, tell me about energy\!

mission.properties|m.great_escape_1a: Surprise\! Looks like you took the bait. That's good, because I needed test subjects for my latest invention.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4b: Skill points are gained regularly as a sprite levels up. They can be applied to skills within the battle sprite interface. \n\nWhen applying a skill point, you must choose an augment to increase, such as the cooldown rate or overall damage.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_2a: Thanks\! I'm off to explore now.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_1a: I understand that Spiral HQ has uncovered the nature of Project R.

mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder_spark:
The Iron Law is Broken\! 
The Crimson Order is False\! 
The Nine are blind, they cannot see the Truth that lies below. 
The Nine are deaf, they cannot hear the Resonance that beats within this world. 

Herex no longer serves as one of the Nine. 
Only Herex sees and hears the Truth. Only Herex will prevail. 
Follow Herex and you will be spared.

mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!

- It is the DUTY of every Gremlin to repel the metal intruders\! 

- Every Gremlin must work to destroy Haven. Cradle belongs us\! 

- Every Gremlin must remain LOYAL to King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. The Iron Law must be obeyed\!

uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!

mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r4: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
mission.properties|b.occurance_at_owlite:
An unlikely source of intel has surfaced from the residents of Moorcroft Manor.  A few of the spookats that call it home contacted one of our visiting Recon Knights and provided details of the negative energy mass that has appeared above the Core. 

Calling it 'a place of burning hatred' and 'a prison for dark souls' they say that you can read all about it in 'one of those weird Owlite books' in an Owlite keep they pinpointed. 

If what they claim is true Spiral HQ could gain valuable intel from investigating the Owlite keep.  Just remember that these Owlite structures have all proven to be swarming with the lost souls of countless undead monsters.  Prepare accordingly.

mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.

dungeon.properties|m.vip_tos:
This C.U.B.E. Club Membership Agreement constitutes a binding legal document between the undersigned (the "knight"), Golden Casino Holdings LLC (the "Casino"), and the entire slime community ("slimes").

 I. General Terms and Conditions
  1. Membership in the C.U.B.E. Club is for personal use only and can not be transferred to other knights, Devilites, or other Clockwork creatures.
  2. Selling access to your ability to spin is prohibited.
  3. Keep your arms and legs inside the Casino at all times.
  4. Please do not drop items into the core.
 II. Description of Benefits
  1. Benefits are varied and may be changed at any time.
  2. Lounge access is not guaranteed and limited by availability.
  3. Buffalo Wings are not included.
  4. All disputes will be arbitrated by the Casino floor manager and all decisions are final.
 III. Winnings, Payments, and Fees
  1. Winnings may be paid in Golden Slime Coins at the discretion of the Casino floor manager.
  2. No additional fees are collected at this time.
 IV. Promotional Awards
  1. Sale promotions\: Reduced prices for members, if any, will be displayed plainly in the shop interface.
  2. The Gift Shop reserves the right to modify, alter, discontinue or terminate these promotions at any time for any reason whatsoever without notice to the end users. No whiners.
 V. Restrictions and Conditions of Use
  1. As a condition of your use of the club services, you agree not to use club facilities or interfaces for any purpose that is unlawful or prohibited by the terms, conditions, and notices included in this Membership Agreement or any relevant Licence Agreement, or anything generally regarded as uncouth by the slimes.
  2. The Spiral Knights Terms of Service supersedes these terms where applicable.
  3. The knight agrees to all terms and conditions enumerated here, and those not enumerated here. The slimes may add new conditions at any time that require complete retroactive compliance.
 VI. Termination of Account
  1. The Casino has the right to terminate your membership for violating any terms or conditions, precise or vague, enumerated herein or generated at the time of infraction. You've been warned.
 VII. Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability
  1. Your use of the Casino is at your sole risk. You click it, you bought it.
  2. The Casino nor the general slime community shall not be liable in contract, tort, negligence or otherwise for any loss or damage whatsoever arising from or in any way connected with your use of the Casino.
 VIII. General
  1. This Membership Agreement is governed by the laws of Haven and the laws of Cradle. You hereby irrevocably consent to submit to the jurisdictions of the Courts of Cradle and Haven.
  2. This agreement was written by a few slimes with little grasp of legal language beyond what they saw when watching A Few Good Men. Thus, any parts that don't make sense are usually blamed on the other guy. Any good parts left over are still good. They don't go bad just because we screwed up on the other badder parts. There's a word for that concept and the fact that we don't know it is one of the bad parts.

The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.

mission.properties|b.shocking_sentient_s:
Recon Knights have uncovered a secret weapons facility that according to the intel we have available, could belong to a high ranking gremlin of The Crimson Order.  It is heavily fortified by a small army of electrified constructs who have no doubt been programmed to defend the facility at all costs. 

While it is unclear if this weapons stash actually belongs to a gremlin of The Crimson Order, it is no less worth infiltrating and neutralizing the weapons stash. 

It is advised that you prepare yourself with elemental damage and shock resistant gear before deploying.

mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!

mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

mission.properties|m.honor_duty_3a:
Aye, as do we all. 

Now then, {0}, you need to prepare for what's to come.  Reaching the Core is only the beginning for us.  I suspect that Spiral HQ will be issuing you many more missions in the future that could only be taken on by someone of your ability. 

And finally, it is my pleasure to inform you that you will soon be awarded one of the greatest honors of the Spiral Knights, the rank of Vanguard.  I will see you in the Hall of Heroes.
conversation.properties|m.dark_harvest_e:
Welcome to the Dark Harvest Festival\!  This annual celebration honors the undead with festive masks, delicious treats and dangerous tricks\!

To participate, explore the Clockworks and try to find the legendary 'Punkin King.'  This ghoulish gourd gives out candy to visitors.  You can exchange the candy to the traders here in the Haven Town Square for monster masks\!

Should you prefer the direct approach, or just need a few more, our vendor will sell you candy as well.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|r.honor_duty_2a: I hope her findings produce something meaningful.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r6: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
chat.properties|m.away_set: Auto-response message set. Use /back to turn it off.
item.properties|f.serene_helm: An ancient, resilient helmet covered in a soft layer of moss.  Within the cool, stony interior of this helmet you can hear a faint and soothing song formed by the rustle of winds traveling from distant lands.
mission.properties|b.axes_of_evil: A gremlin logging operation has been discovered in levels known as the 'Jigsaw Valley.'  These strangely carved islands are home to an even stranger species of twisting trees that gremlins seem to be determined to completely wipe out. \n\nSpiral HQ believes that gremlins are using the lumber from this operation as resources for the development of Project R and needs you to enter the Jigsaw Valley and shut it down.
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak: A simple feathered cloak. Adorn yourself in down and get down for the new year.
guild.properties|e.guild_in_default: Sorry, that guild is in-default. Try again later.
item.properties|f.heavy_crystal_bomb: A solid chunk of alloy with an explosive surprise inside. Zombies hate surprises.
conversation.properties|m.npc_teaser_kni: This last mission sure was a strange one. We were clearing the way to an elevator when we saw some odd structures off in the distance. We couldn't see any way to reach them though.  I guess we'll just have to keep an eye out for them in the future.  The Clockworks is ever-shifting after all.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_cap: A thick hat that smells heavily of barbecue. Barbecued what? Don't ask.
chat.properties|m.usage_recharge: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCharges a player (yourself by default) up with mist energy.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_6a: Something has happened\!  That door just popped up behind you like a trap\! \n\nDefend yourself, {0}\!
item.properties|f.blazebreak_helm: A reliable helmet that'll come in handy when the heat is on.
dungeon.properties|m.training_1_desc: Explore this derelict portion of the Clockworks and learn the basics required for survival.
social.properties|m.not_here: There is no knight named {0} here.
item.properties|f.nightblade: A short slicer infused with the essence of the Underworld.
item.properties|f.fiend_portal_key: Using this will allow you to open and pass through the Grim Gate in the Ancient Grove.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl_vol: A beaked mask shrouded in a scorched hood. Herald in the new year in this elemental gown.
item.properties|f.wrapping_paper: Wrap an item in this decorative gift box and add a personalized message.
helptips.properties|m.loading12: If you experience a problem of any kind, press F2 to send a bug report.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_3a: Amazing that after all this time we didn't know the truth. I mean, we've suspected for a while now that this planet was some kind of prison but who could have guessed that this 'Swarm' was just waiting for someone to stumble across the Core and free it?
item.properties|f.hazardous_diablo_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a demon said to have broken off its own horn to use as a weapon when it faced its end.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_red: A Spiral-issued light source typically installed in dangerous areas.
mission.properties|m.once_only: This mission can only be played once per day.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_2a: It is now. I was just on my way to the bazaar to drop off some supplies when I was ambushed by these gremlins. I thought they were from Emberlight, a colony of gremlin outcasts, but it looks like I was mistaken. \n\nJust to be safe, would you mind helping me get these items to the bazaar?
item.properties|f.blight_needle: It's a proven fact that even the most virulent of toxins is a lot more contagious if it's fired indiscriminately over a large area.
item.properties|f.mercurial_helm: A sublime silver helmet that'll let you move as swiftly as water, though perhaps not quite so swiftly *through* it.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_gre: A tall torch filled with ghastly green fire.
item.properties|f.starlit_hunting_cap: An advanced hunting cap, illuminated and downy, that resists the strongest sleep mists.
item.properties|f.prize_box_slime: Contains various unique costumes and items that augment the Jelly series of gear. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.prize_box_vile: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Vile style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.vile_seal: A small scrap of ancient parchment imbued with dark magicks. It is believed that they grant power to those with evil souls.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: None know for sure. Tinkinzar not seen for many many years. Crimson Order carries out Tinkinzar's plans for Cradle. Emberlight was blight on master plan because built by outcasts. Haven probably the same, founded by non-gremlins. Not part of plan\!
item.properties|f.master_blaster: This advanced sidearm is an excellent choice if your adventuring party happens to need another hero.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_3: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap.\n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
item.properties|f.spiral_hood: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.seraphynx_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Seraphynx Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies divine light. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat with protection and restoration.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Grantz he...he fell while protecting us from The Swarm. He stood his ground even when the rest of us were forced to flee. I'll never forget how brave he was.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_9a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_suit: A suit snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells a bit sweaty.
item.properties|f.fireburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of fire.
item.properties|f.nitronome: An advanced explosive issued to only the most elite Spiral Knight grenadiers. It's made from a synthetic substance that ticks ominously even when unarmed.
conversation.properties|m.rc_bomb_1a: Had a chance to try out bombs yet? Unlike other weapon types, bombs can only be used as a charge attack. Doing anything else just causes it to fizzle out. But if you do charge them up... BOOM\! They can put a serious hurt on multiple monsters at once\!
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_helm: A vestigial helm whose weight makes it unwieldy to all but those with titanic strength.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_3a: Great, thanks for being a good ambassador\! \n\nLastly I need to get you up to speed on something called 'energy.'  It's very important to your mission here on Cradle.
item.properties|f.frayed_fabric: The worn remains of a Clockworks denizen's duds. It could probably be recycled.
item.properties|f.heavy_dark_matter_bomb: A solid chunk of Dark Matter with an explosive surprise inside. Gremlins hate surprises.
item.properties|f.sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
item.properties|f.pulsar: A high-tech Gremlin firearm originally designed for use by elite squads of Ironclaw soldiers. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 2 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
social.properties|m.friend_request_pendi: You have already sent a friend request to {0}.
item.properties|f.catalyzer: An advanced alchemical armament adapted from Gremlin mining and demolition devices. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_companion: Contains various items for your sprite and a chance for rarities. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
sprites.properties|d.chaotic_haze: Targets damaged by hexing haze have a chance of receiving a random status condition.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
item.properties|f.kat_claw_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
conversation.properties|m.em_greeter_1a: Welcome to Emberlight, sanctuary for outcast gremlins.
helptips.properties|m.converse: Use the arrow keys and spacebar to navigate the conversation.
dungeon.properties|m.aurora_isles_desc: From atop mysterious floating islands, sun bleached ruins crumble under a false sky. Though the green grass and cool air feels real enough, the ever present grinding of the machine just below the surface is a constant reminder of this world's mechanical skeleton.
item.properties|f.boltbrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a powerful electrical discharge that is harmless to knights.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1a: Greetings, {0}. I imagine you have some questions about battle sprites. How can I assist you?
item.properties|f.flawed_snowball: A hard-packed snowball that is unfortunately too flawed for use in alchemy. It would be best to simply throw it away... at someone's head.
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_suit: A demo suit made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
helptips.properties|m.atg_teblocks: TIMED EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will count down to 0 before exploding and causing damage.
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that produces a noxious cloud of toxins.
helptips.properties|m.tut_goldkey: Pick up and use on Gold Doors\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.polar_day_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending day patrols.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_gobble_: A festive fall snipe that will stay where it's placed.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_freeze: A frosty theme that turns Guild Halls into a popular retreat during the warm, summer months on Cradle.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2d: Your lessons have energized me\! I'm off to adventure, bye\!
item.properties|f.celestial_shield: Cradle's equinox inspired the dual nature of this specialist shield, which protects against the dazzling light of day and the chill of night in equal measure.
item.properties|f.scalding_hot_cocoa: A singeing splash of sweet destruction awaits any foe that goes for this mug before it's had a chance to cool.
global.properties|m.idled_out: You have been disconnected due to idleness.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|b.skies_under_cradle: The Clockworks are a fascinating underground complex that houses entire worlds within its colossal, iron geo-globes.  One of them that recon knights have discovered is known as the 'Aurora Isles,' a series of mysterious floating islands under a false sky. \n\nAs a newly ranked Apprentice, you now have clearance to explore the ruins within these islands and collect any useful materials you may discover.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro_1a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.kat_claw_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Clawers, the fearsome frontline fighters of the Kat Tribe.
helptips.properties|m.sprite_cooldown: After using any sprite skill, a cooldown is required on all skills before using them again.
helptips.properties|m.atg_switch: Switch out of reach?  Throw a pot or shoot it with a gun\!
item.properties|f.permafroster: Tech Knights are not yet sure if targets of this deep-freezing handgun ever actually defrost. So far, 'no.' Permafroster shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|d.supply_depot_explan: The Supply Depot is full of items for sale. As you complete missions, more items will become available.
item.properties|f.sorcerer_robe: A fine robe known to be worn by powerful sorcerers, and this one guy Bob.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_311da7: Hit the Whammie playing the Golden Prize Wheel.
guild.properties|e.design_full: Sorry, design mode is already occupied by the maximum number of editors.
social.properties|m.join_friend: Join your friend {0} at depth {1} in the {2} Gate\!
helptips.properties|m.loading0: The basic play controls can be viewed at any time by pressing [[TOGGLE_HELP]].
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3b: A "gate" is an entry point into the Clockworks. They take the form of the lifts you see before you. Each gate has a display monitor showing the gate's unique icon as well as a control panel that allows the user to enter the gate. This gate here will always take you to the same place, but other gates have shifting floors beneath them. In those, you never quite know what's next\!
support.properties|m.header_step1: You are about to file a complaint against another player for the Game Masters to review.
helptips.properties|m.tut_shrubs: Try clearing out these shrubs. Plants and other destructible objects often hide treasures.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_1a: Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like some directions?
chat.properties|m.usage_fire: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nFires an effect in the scene.
item.properties|f.pig_armor: Hog all the attention in this leather suit. Its durable protection may just save your bacon one day.
item.properties|f.virulisk_suit: A thick set of gear crafted from the carcass of a Virulisk. Wearers will inherit some of the Virulisk's poison resistance, as well as its taste for flan.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_delete: To confirm deletion of this character, type "{0}" below.
item.properties|f.horned_owlite_shield: A sturdy shield similar to the sort said to have been carried by Owlite youth.
chat.properties|m.no_such_gift: {0} has no gifts of that type.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_d: Between the warmth of the fire and the safety of the defensive turrets, I think I'll sleep well tonight.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
chat.properties|m.usage_grin: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nGrin at your fellow players.
item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_armor: A powerful suit of armor said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
mission.properties|b.work_idle_hands:
Devilites are a type of fiend that seem to have a very rigid corporate structure that governs their every action.  Recon Knights have discovered a series of devilite 'offices' throughout the Clockworks, typically found in the remains of an alien city. 

Analysis of the data collected from these offices indicates that devilite corporations are outsourced by gremlins in order to design and manage various projects that include weapons specifically engineered to target Spiral Knight squads. 

It's time these devilites were issued pink slips and their fiendish projects cancelled.
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_core_desc: A small terminal in the darkest depths of the Clockworks that looks out on to the colossal, ever-beating heart of the world.
item.properties|f.harlequin_suit: A costume for those who juggle, tumble, or have the gift of mischief.
item.properties|f.argent_peacemaker: An ancient handgun forged from sun silver. Its bullets serve as ushers for those that refuse to leave this world.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_2a: Lord Vanaduke rules over the citadel now.  His soul bound to some horrific armored prison. \n\nHe has the citadel ready for battle at all times, believing that his kingdom is still under siege.  He doesn't even realize that what he is trying to protect was lost a thousand years ago.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_2a: To the West, you will learn about useful items found in the Clockworks. To the North, you will learn about a variety of block types and doors. To the East, you will find an array of traps and hazards as well as a combat room to practice defense against training cubes.  Don't worry, we have taken precautions to make sure the cubes are perfectly harmless\!
logon.properties|m.peer_redirect: You are logged into a different peer. Redirecting...
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_1a: Thank you Kora, I'm just as glad as anyone to have Haven safe once more.
item.properties|f.tempered_calibur: A Calibur reforged and tempered by the most advanced techniques available to weaponsmiths of the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.calibur: A standard issue sword awarded to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
dungeon.properties|e.spin_halted: Sorry, the Casino is now closed for business. Come back next time.
helptips.properties|m.tut_weapons_short: Use [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to cycle your equipped weapon.
mission.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_suit: A bony barrier that throbs with malevolence. Anyone skeptical of this suit's power deserves a good ribbing.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Do you have any more questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_1a: Greetings, recruit.  Always good to see another knight make it to the Rescue Camp.  I imagine you're looking to prepare for your journey to Haven.  A good place to start is the gate here into the Clockworks.  Simply approach the control panel at the north end of the lift and press the action button ([[?ACTION]]).\n\nAny questions?
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_8: This gremlin comes from the colony of Emberlight, deep within the Clockworks. They're a group of outcasts that have defied King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. We're hoping we can make a treaty with them that will allow us to use their colony as a base of operations for our missions deeper underground.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones clad in gold armor are invincible.
item.properties|f.peppermint_repeater: This holiday hand cannon is the proper piece to pepper your opponents with hot lead of holiday cheer.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1b: What services can I find here? (Follow Tylen)
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_8: Yes indeed\!  That's because every time you transmute an item through alchemy, there is a chance you can get one of several Unique Variants that makes your item much more powerful\!
item.properties|f.kat_eye_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
mission.properties|b.new_chapter: Having defeated the Snarbolax and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about certification in the Hall of Heroes.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_4a: Accept my mission and let's get to work blowing some stuff up\!
chat.properties|m.usage_get_values: Usage\: /{0}\nGet the current spawn floor values.
conversation.properties|m.core_guard_1: You should go speak with Vaelyn.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_1a:
Listen up, Rangers\! Spiral HQ has received a very cryptic distress signal from some completely unknown facility deep within the Clockworks. 

The way I figure, we're about to dive head first into either a perilous rescue mission or a death trap. Either way, your means of resolving the situation resides in your arsenal right now. So get geared up, and get ready for combat. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...
item.properties|f.prize_box_polar: Contains various unique costumes and accessories popular in the polar regions. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.frost_gel: A drop of chilly gunk collected from a cool Clockworks customer.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_3a: At 4 and 5 star level, gear offers the best protection you can find and weapons pack the biggest punch.  If you want to stay alive where you're heading, you need to start building an arsenal of 4 and 5 star gear. \n\nAnd remember- as items reach 5 star they typically can branch even more than before.  Your combat options are about to really open up.  Plan your arsenal with care.
mission.properties|b.sewer_stash: It seems that the Ironclaw Munitions Factory is not the only place gremlins are storing high-powered weaponry.  Intel suggests that once manufactured, weapons are moved out of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory and stored in secret weapon caches throughout the Clockworks. \n\nOne of these caches has been uncovered in one of the Clockwork's wasteworks systems.  It's likely not going to be pretty reaching it, but eliminating the weapons stored in these wasteworks could result in far fewer casualties in the future.
